overall.assessment: Na temelju dostavljenog tematskog pregleda, podcast uglavnom promiče kršćansko poštovanje života, odgovorno očinstvo, obiteljsku skrb, vjerski odgoj i laičko zauzimanje za opće dobro, a osobna svjedočanstva o Julijanu, Kruni i Šimunu daju tim temama konkretnu ljudsku dimenziju. Posebno je vrijedno što se pro-life zauzimanje povezuje s odgovornošću muškaraca, roditeljskom prisutnošću i pomoći obiteljima, a ne samo s političkim stavom; takav široki pogled odgovara katoličkom shvaćanju kulture života koja brani život od začeća, ali obuhvaća i obrazovanje, rad, zdravlje i skrb za ranjive. Istodobno, nazivi poput „woke“, „uhljebnički sustav“ i općenite političke podjele mogu, ako se u razgovoru koriste bez razlikovanja i provjere činjenica, pojačati polarizaciju umjesto susreta, dok tvrdnja „bez Krista nema spasenja“ traži pažljivo katehetsko objašnjenje kako ne bi zvučala kao osuda konkretnih osoba. Budući da je dostupna samo struktura epizode, a ne njezin puni sadržaj, ocjena se odnosi na naznačene teme i njihov mogući teološki smjer, ne na svaku izrečenu tvrdnju ili način argumentacije.
seeds_of_logos: Zauzimanje za nerođeno dijete i podrška trudnicama i obiteljima u teškim okolnostima svjedoče o dostojanstvu ranjivog ljudskog života; biblijski izvori prikazuju Boga kao onoga koji poznaje i oblikuje čovjeka već u majčinoj utrobi.
Naglasak na prisutnosti oca, odgovornosti roditelja i nezamjenjivosti obiteljskog odgoja ističe da je skrb za djecu duhovna i moralna odgovornost, a ne samo materijalno uzdržavanje.
Vjeronauk, svjedočenje vjere i javno sudjelovanje laika mogu biti važan doprinos odgoju mladih i općem dobru, pod uvjetom da su praćeni oblikovanjem savjesti i odgovornim moralnim prosuđivanjem.

Priče o prihvaćanju djece, bolesti, obiteljskom naporu i nastanku obiteljskog posla mogu pokazati kako se patnja i zahvalnost pretvaraju u služenje i konkretan rad za druge, bez svođenja ljudske vrijednosti na zdravlje ili uspjeh.
Priznanje odgovornosti muškaraca za pobačaj i očinsku odsutnost može osnažiti poziv na odgovorno očinstvo i solidarnost, umjesto da se krivnja jednostrano prebacuje na žene.
concerns: Politički i kulturni izrazi poput „woke gradova“, „uhljebničkog sustava“ ili „ljevica u Hrvatskoj“, ako se ne potkrijepe argumentima i ne razlikuju ideje od osoba, mogu skliznuti u karikiranje protivnika i oslabiti dijalog. Katoličko sudjelovanje javnom životu zahtijeva istinu, razboritost, civilnost i spremnost na suradnju, ne samo suprotstavljanje.

Pogled na život i politiku treba ostati cjelovit: zaštita nerođenih ima osobitu težinu, ali katolička kultura života obuhvaća i siromaštvo, obrazovanje, zdravstvo, rad i druge prijetnje dostojanstvu osobe; svođenje društvenog nauka na jedan skup pitanja bilo bi redukcionističko.

Kritika radikalnog feminizma može otvoriti važan razgovor o odgovornosti i ravnopravnom dostojanstvu, ali treba izbjegavati široke osude žena ili feminističkih nastojanja bez razlikovanja njihovih ciljeva i postupaka.

Tvrdnja „bez Krista nema spasenja“ zahtijeva kontekstualizaciju u cjelovitom katoličkom nauku o Kristu i spasenju; prema samom pregledu nije moguće procijeniti je li u podcastu objašnjena pastoralno i teološki precizno.
overall.theological_context: Evangelium Vitae daje okvir za zauzimanje za ljudski život i kulturu života, dok katolički društveni nauk povezuje obranu života s dostojanstvom svake osobe i širim pitanjima općeg dobra. Evangelii Gaudium i Fratelli Tutti podupiru javno djelovanje koje uključuje oblikovanje savjesti, kritičko prosuđivanje, otvoren dijalog i suradnju, a Efežanima 4,29–32 podsjeća da se protiv zla ne smije boriti ogorčenošću, klevetom ili zlonamjernošću. Biblijski prikaz Božjeg djelovanja u utrobi podupire poštovanje nerođenog života, dok crkveno promišljanje o obitelji ističe odgovornost roditelja za duhovnu i materijalnu dobrobit djece.

overall.assessment_en: Based on the provided thematic overview, the podcast mostly promotes Christian respect for life, responsible fatherhood, family care, religious education, and lay engagement for the common good, while the personal testimonies about Julijan, Kruno, and Šimun give these themes a concrete human dimension. It is especially valuable that pro-life engagement is linked to men's responsibility, parental presence, and help for families, and not only to a political stance; such a broad view corresponds to the Catholic understanding of the culture of life, which defends life from conception, but also encompasses education, work, health, and care for the vulnerable. At the same time, terms like "woke", "crony system", and general political divisions can, if used in conversation without distinction and fact-checking, intensify polarization instead of encounter, while the claim "without Christ there is no salvation" requires careful catechetical explanation so as not to sound like a condemnation of concrete individuals. Since only the structure of the episode is available, and not its full content, the assessment refers to the indicated themes and their possible theological direction, not to every uttered claim or manner of argumentation.
overall.theological_context_en: Evangelium Vitae provides the framework for engagement for human life and the culture of life, while Catholic social teaching links the defense of life with the dignity of every person and broader issues of the common good. Evangelii Gaudium and Fratelli Tutti support public action that includes the formation of conscience, critical judgment, open dialogue, and cooperation, and Ephesians 4:29–32 reminds that evil must not be fought with bitterness, slander, or malice. The biblical portrayal of God's action in the womb supports respect for unborn life, while the Church's reflection on the family emphasizes the responsibility of parents for the spiritual and material well-being of children.
seeds_of_logos_en: Engagement for the unborn child and support for pregnant women and families in difficult circumstances bear witness to the dignity of vulnerable human life; biblical sources portray God as the one who knows and forms man already in the mother's womb.

The emphasis on the father's presence, the responsibility of parents, and the irreplaceability of family upbringing highlights that care for children is a spiritual and moral responsibility, not merely material support.

Religious education, witnessing to the faith, and public participation of the laity can be an important contribution to the upbringing of youth and the common good, provided they are accompanied by the formation of conscience and responsible moral judgment.

Stories of accepting children, illness, family effort, and the emergence of a family business can show how suffering and gratitude are transformed into service and concrete work for others, without reducing human worth to health or success.
Acknowledging men's responsibility for abortion and fatherly absence can strengthen the call to responsible fatherhood and solidarity, instead of unilaterally shifting blame onto women.
concerns_en: Political and cultural expressions such as "woke cities", "crony system", or "the left in Croatia", if not supported by arguments and if they do not distinguish ideas from persons, can slip into caricaturing opponents and weaken dialogue. Catholic participation in public life requires truth, prudence, civility, and readiness for cooperation, not only opposition.

The view of life and politics should remain integral: the protection of the unborn carries particular weight, but the Catholic culture of life also encompasses poverty, education, healthcare, work, and other threats to the dignity of the person; reducing social teaching to a single set of issues would be reductionist.

Critique of radical feminism can open an important conversation about responsibility and equal dignity, but broad condemnations of women or feminist endeavors without distinguishing their goals and actions should be avoided.

The claim "without Christ there is no salvation" requires contextualization within the integral Catholic teaching on Christ and salvation; based on the overview alone, it is not possible to assess whether it was explained pastorally and theologically precisely in the podcast.

sections.subtitle: „Ljudina“ s mnogo epiteta: Ivan Pokupec gost druge epizode Redefinicije
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj Kruno predstavlja gosta Ivana Pokupca i nabraja njegove epitete
sections.content:
Druga epizoda podcasta **Redefinicija** na kanalu *Muževni budite* otvara se katoličkim pozdravom: „Hvaljen Isus i Marija i sveti Josip!“ Voditelj Kruno potom predstavlja gosta, **Ivana Pokupca**, kojeg opisuje kao „zanimljiv lik“ i „ljudinu“.

Kruno nabraja niz epiteta koji prate njegova sugovornika:
- aktivist,
- javni zagovornik vrijednosti braka, života i obitelji,
- „kontroverzni vjeroučitelj“.

Voditelj naglašava da je epiteta mnogo i da će se nekih tijekom razgovora dotaknuti. Pokupec zahvaljuje na pozivu i u šali dodaje da su neki drugi epiteti zanimljiviji te da će o njima biti riječi „along the way“. Tim tonom, opuštenim, ali i otvoreno provokativnim, započinje razgovor koji će obuhvatiti aktivizam, politiku, školstvo, očinstvo, feminizam i javno svjedočenje vjere.

magisterium.assessment: Ovaj uvodni odlomak ne iznosi razrađene teološke tvrdnje koje bi se mogle ocijeniti kao usklađene ili neusklađene s naukom Crkve; katolički pozdrav i spominjanje zagovaranja braka, života i obitelji sami po sebi nisu problematični. Procjena je zato privremena i odnosi se samo na predstavljeni uvod, a ne na kasniji sadržaj razgovora.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk potvrđuje dostojanstvo ljudskog života te važnost braka i obitelji, ali njihovo javno zagovaranje treba biti povezano s poštovanjem i osjetljivošću prema osobama u konkretnim životnim okolnostima. Crkva svjedoči istinu i milosrđe zajedno, pa sami epiteti gosta ne govore još dovoljno o tome kako će te vrijednosti biti predstavljene u razgovoru.
magisterium.assessment_en: This introductory paragraph does not present elaborate theological claims that could be evaluated as aligned or unaligned with the teaching of the Church; the Catholic greeting and the mention of advocating for marriage, life, and family are not problematic in themselves. The assessment is therefore provisional and refers only to the presented introduction, and not to the later content of the conversation.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching confirms the dignity of human life and the importance of marriage and family, but their public advocacy should be connected with respect and sensitivity toward persons in concrete life circumstances. The Church witnesses to truth and mercy together, so the guest's epithets themselves do not yet say enough about how these values will be presented in the conversation.

sections.subtitle_en: „A great man“ with many epithets: Ivan Pokupec guest of the second episode of Redefinicija
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host Kruno introduces the guest Ivan Pokupec and lists his epithets
sections.content_en:
The second episode of the podcast **Redefinicija** on the channel *Muževni budite* opens with the Catholic greeting: „Praise be to Jesus and Mary and Saint Joseph!“ Host Kruno then introduces the guest, **Ivan Pokupec**, whom he describes as an „interesting character“ and „a great man“.

Kruno lists a series of epithets that follow his interlocutor:
- activist,
- public advocate for the values of marriage, life, and family,
- „controversial religion teacher“.

The host emphasizes that there are many epithets and that they will touch upon some of them during the conversation. Pokupec thanks him for the invitation and jokingly adds that some other epithets are more interesting and that they will be discussed „along the way“. In that tone, relaxed, but also openly provocative, begins the conversation that will cover activism, politics, schooling, fatherhood, feminism, and public witnessing of faith.

sections.subtitle: Sve je počelo na parkiralištu: od „sebičnog“ okidača do humanitarnog aktivizma
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec opisuje problem s parkiranjem iza zgrade KBF-a u Vlaškoj
sections.content:
Na pitanje što je bio okidač njegova društvenog angažmana, Ivan Pokupec iskreno odgovara da su to bili **„sebični razlozi“**. Godine 2005. upisao je Katehetski institut na Katoličkom bogoslovnom fakultetu, smješten u Vlaškoj, u samom središtu Zagreba. Onamo je svakodnevno putovao iz Velike Gorice, a predavanja su ponekad trajala od jutra do kasnog poslijepodneva. Parkiranje mu je zato postalo velik problem.

Iza zgrade KBF-a isprva se nalazio raskopani prostor, gotovo gradilište, na kojem se moglo slobodno parkirati. Pokupec ga opisuje kao prostor između KBF-a i zgrade Nacionala, gdje će, kako navodi, dvije godine kasnije biti počinjen atentat na Pukanića. Kada je ondje uređeno službeno parkiralište koje se naplaćivalo, mladi student „bez love“ našao se u nevolji.

Tada je primijetio da su rijetka žuta parkirna mjesta za osobe s invaliditetom u centru grada u pravilu zauzeta „divljim markama automobila“ bez ikakve oznake da ih vozi osoba s invaliditetom. Kako sam kaže, aktivizam mu je počeo pitanjem kako riješiti vlastiti problem, a zatim i problem ostalih osoba s invaliditetom pri parkiranju u središtu Zagreba. Prvi aktivistički koraci tako su ga doveli u sukob sa Zagreb parkingom, odnosno s pokojnim gospodinom Bandićem.

Kada je taj problem riješio, aktivizam se proširio na **djecu s teškoćama u razvoju** i poprimio humanitarni karakter. Pokupec govori o „desecima, stotinama akcija“ za djecu s teškoćama u razvoju i osobe s invaliditetom, kojima je stekao određeni studentski renome. Sazrijevanjem je, međutim, shvatio da je i humanitarni aktivizam dobrim dijelom **„jedan veliki, ponekad i prljavi biznis“**. Nakon toga se na nekoliko godina povukao iz aktivizma.

Ponovno ga je, kako kaže, „čisto zbog emocije“ pokrenuo prizor dramatičnih deložacija 2015. godine, kada ulazi u politički aktivizam. Ističe da uvijek kasni u sazrijevanjima. Danas svoj aktivizam smatra možda najslobodnijim dosad jer više nije vezan ni uz jednu organizaciju niti o ikome financijski ovisi. Aktivizmom se, kaže, bavi „sebi za gušt“, u slobodno vrijeme, i može slobodno reći što misli.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak uglavnom je usklađen s katoličkim naukom jer prikazuje zauzimanje za osobe s invaliditetom, djecu s teškoćama i obitelji suočene s deložacijom kao oblike solidarnosti i skrbi za ranjive. Ipak, riječ je pretežno o osobnom prikazu aktivizma, a ne o izričitom promicanju kršćanskih motiva ili nauka.
concerns: Tvrdnja da je humanitarni aktivizam ponekad „prljavi biznis” može upozoriti na stvarne zloupotrebe, ali bez pojašnjenja može potaknuti neopravdanu sumnju prema humanitarnom radu općenito.

Početni „sebični razlozi” i djelovanje „sebi za gušt” sami po sebi ne dokazuju moralno pogrešan čin, ali odlomak ne razrađuje kako osobni interes i emocionalni poticaj trebaju biti pročišćeni ljubavlju prema bližnjemu.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk naglašava da osobe s invaliditetom imaju nepovredivo dostojanstvo te da njihovo uključivanje i potpora nisu puka dobročinstva, nego odgovornost zajednice i izraz ljubavi prema najranjivijima. Isusovo poistovjećivanje s onima kojima služimo — „to ste meni učinili” — daje takvoj skrbi dublji evanđeoski smisao, dok kršćansko služenje slijedi Kristov primjer, koji je došao služiti. Stoga je korisno razlikovati kritiku konkretnih zloupotreba od omalovažavanja same karitativne djelatnosti, koja treba ostati besplatna i usmjerena na dobro osobe kojoj se pomaže.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is largely aligned with Catholic teaching because it portrays advocacy for persons with disabilities, children with difficulties, and families facing eviction as forms of solidarity and care for the vulnerable. Nevertheless, it is predominantly a personal account of activism, rather than an explicit promotion of Christian motives or teaching.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching emphasizes that persons with disabilities have an inviolable dignity and that their inclusion and support are not mere charity, but a responsibility of the community and an expression of love toward the most vulnerable. Jesus' identification with those whom we serve — „you did it to me” — gives such care a deeper evangelical meaning, while Christian service follows the example of Christ, who came to serve. Therefore, it is useful to distinguish the critique of concrete abuses from the belittling of charitable activity itself, which should remain gratuitous and directed toward the good of the person being helped.
concerns_en: The claim that humanitarian activism is sometimes a „dirty business” can warn of real abuses, but without clarification it can encourage unjustified suspicion toward humanitarian work in general.

Initial „selfish reasons” and acting „for one's own pleasure” do not in themselves prove a morally wrong act, but the passage does not elaborate on how personal interest and emotional impulse ought to be purified by love of neighbor.

sections.subtitle_en: Everything began in a parking lot: from a „selfish“ trigger to humanitarian activism
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec describes the parking problem behind the KBF building in Vlaška
sections.content_en:
To the question of what was the trigger of his social engagement, Ivan Pokupec honestly answers that it was **„selfish reasons“**. In the year 2005, he enrolled in the Katehetski institut at the Katolički bogoslovni fakultet, located in Vlaška, in the very center of Zagreb. He traveled there daily from Velika Gorica, and lectures sometimes lasted from morning until late afternoon. Parking therefore became a big problem for him.

Behind the KBF building there was initially a dug-up space, almost a construction site, where one could park freely. Pokupec describes it as a space between KBF and the Nacional building, where, as he states, two years later the assassination of Pukanić would be committed. When an official parking lot that charged a fee was set up there, the young student „without money“ found himself in trouble.

Then he noticed that the rare yellow parking spaces for persons with disabilities in the city center were, as a rule, occupied by „wild car brands“ without any mark indicating that they were driven by a person with a disability. As he says himself, his activism began with the question of how to solve his own problem, and then also the problem of other persons with disabilities when parking in the center of Zagreb. His first activist steps thus brought him into conflict with Zagreb parking, that is, with the late Mr. Bandić.

When he solved that problem, the activism expanded to **children with developmental difficulties** and took on a humanitarian character. Pokupec speaks of „dozens, hundreds of actions“ for children with developmental difficulties and persons with disabilities, through which he gained a certain student reputation. Through maturing, however, he realized that humanitarian activism is also largely **„one big, sometimes also dirty business“**. After that, he withdrew from activism for several years.

He was set in motion again, as he says, „purely because of emotion“ by the sight of dramatic evictions in 2015, when he entered political activism. He emphasizes that he is always late in maturing. Today, he considers his activism perhaps the freest so far because he is no longer tied to any organization nor financially dependent on anyone. He engages in activism, he says, „for his own pleasure“, in his free time, and he can freely say what he thinks.
keywords_en: parking spaces for persons with disabilities

sections.subtitle: Živi zid i Slobodna Hrvatska: ponos bez žaljenja, ali i lekcija za budućnost
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec govori o izlasku oko 150 članova iz Živog zida i osnivanju Slobodne Hrvatske
sections.content:
Kruno zatim pita gosta kako se danas osvrće na sudjelovanje u političkim opcijama **Živi zid** i **Slobodna Hrvatska** te žali li zbog toga. Odgovor je kratak: ne žali.

Pokupec je Živom zidu pristupio početkom 2015., a napustio ga je krajem iste godine. Ušao je prvenstveno kao aktivist, „kupljen“ emocijom koju su u njemu izazvali dramatični prizori deložacija. Naglašava da nije imao političkih ambicija i da se uključio srcem, iz današnje perspektive „možda i previše“. Unutar stranke brzo je napredovao, kako kaže, zbog razine pismenosti i obrazovanja koju je imao.

Upravo mu je to pomoglo da relativno brzo prepozna **„smicalice i podvale“** na političkoj strani priče u Živom zidu. Krajem 2015. oko 150 članova kolektivno je izašlo iz stranke i osnovalo Slobodnu Hrvatsku. Pokupec ističe razliku: u Živom zidu bili su članovi, a u novoj stranci osnivači. Slobodna Hrvatska nastavila je, prema njegovim riječima, sa sličnim programskim smjernicama.

Na pitanje o žaljenju odlučno odgovara: **„Niti malo, apsolutno.“** Ponosan je na svoju ulogu, kako god priča završila. Priznaje ipak da to danas vjerojatno ne bi ponovio, zbog „vrlo prizemnog“ načina na koji je sve završilo. Namjere su, kaže, bile časne, iskrene i dobre, a unutar tih političkih opcija mnogo je toga dobroga napravio i naučio.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak ne iznosi izričitu teološku tvrdnju, ali opis političkog angažmana, služenja ljudima pogođenima deložacijama i pouke iz političkog iskustva nije u suprotnosti s katoličkim naukom. Katolička je tradicija političko sudjelovanje laika prihvatljiva, pa i poželjna mogućnost, ako je vođeno moralno oblikovanom savješću i usmjereno općem dobru.
concerns: Iz odlomka se ne može procijeniti jesu li programi ni konkretni postupci spomenutih političkih opcija bili u skladu s katoličkim moralnim načelima; dobra namjera sama po sebi nije dovoljna za takvu prosudbu.
Navodi o „smicalicama i podvalama” ostaju osobno svjedočanstvo bez dodatnih pojedinosti, pa ih nije moguće teološki ili činjenično potvrditi.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk ne traži od vjernika povlačenje iz javnog života: laici mogu služiti Bogu i bližnjemu kroz odgovorno političko djelovanje, uz poštovanje dostojanstva svake osobe i usmjerenje prema općem dobru. Istodobno, stranačka pripadnost i politički uspjeh moraju ostati podređeni kršćanskoj savjesti, a politički angažman ne može se opravdati samo iskrenim motivima ako bi konkretni ciljevi ili sredstva bili moralno pogrešni.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage makes no explicit theological claim, but the description of political engagement, serving people affected by evictions, and lessons from political experience is not contrary to Catholic teaching. In Catholic tradition, political participation by the laity is an acceptable, and even desirable possibility, if it is guided by a morally formed conscience and directed toward the common good.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching does not require believers to withdraw from public life: the laity can serve God and neighbor through responsible political action, while respecting the dignity of every person and being oriented toward the common good. At the same time, party affiliation and political success must remain subordinate to Christian conscience, and political engagement cannot be justified merely by sincere motives if the concrete goals or means were morally wrong.
concerns_en: From the passage, it cannot be assessed whether the programs or concrete actions of the mentioned political options were in accordance with Catholic moral principles; good intention by itself is not sufficient for such a judgment.
The claims about "tricks and schemes" remain a personal testimony without further details, so it is not possible to confirm them theologically or factually.

sections.subtitle_en: Živi zid and Slobodna Hrvatska: pride without regret, but also a lesson for the future
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec speaks about the departure of about 150 members from Živi zid and the founding of Slobodna Hrvatska
sections.content_en:
Kruno then asks the guest how he looks back today on his participation in the political options **Živi zid** and **Slobodna Hrvatska**, and whether he regrets it. The answer is brief: he does not regret it.

Pokupec joined Živi zid in early 2015 and left it at the end of the same year. He entered primarily as an activist, "bought" by the emotion evoked in him by the dramatic scenes of evictions. He emphasizes that he had no political ambitions and that he became involved with his heart, from today's perspective "perhaps even too much." Within the party, he advanced quickly, as he says, because of the level of literacy and education he possessed.

It was precisely this that helped him recognize relatively quickly the **"tricks and schemes"** on the political side of the story in Živi zid. At the end of 2015, about 150 members left the party collectively and founded Slobodna Hrvatska. Pokupec emphasizes the difference: in Živi zid they were members, and in the new party they were founders. Slobodna Hrvatska continued, according to his words, with similar program guidelines.

To the question about regret, he answers decisively: **"Not in the slightest, absolutely."** He is proud of his role, however the story ended. He admits, however, that he probably would not repeat it today, because of the "very base" way in which everything ended. The intentions, he says, were honorable, sincere, and good, and within those political options he did and learned a lot of good.

sections.subtitle: „Gradili smo kuću od krova“: duhovno probuđenje kao preduvjet društvene promjene
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec objašnjava metaforu kuće koja se gradi od temelja, a ne od krova
sections.content:
Na temelju političkog iskustva Kruno pita je li društvena promjena moguća samo političkim angažmanom. Pokupec danas zastupa suprotno stajalište: promjena je, prema njegovu mišljenju, moguća **isključivo na neki drugi način**.

Objašnjava to slikovitom metaforom. Sve političke i aktivističke opcije u kojima je sudjelovao, kaže, zapravo su **„gradile kuću od krova umjesto od temelja“**. Danas je uvjeren da je preduvjet za sve duhovno probuđenje, duhovna i psihološka promjena među ljudima kao narodom. Politička promjena, smatra, tek će uslijediti kao posljedica toga, a ne obrnuto, jer „kuću treba graditi od temelja, a ne odozgora“.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak da društvena obnova treba biti ukorijenjena u duhovnoj i moralnoj preobrazbi u skladu je s katoličkim naukom, koji ističe obnovu kršćanskog duha kao temelj društvene obnove. Ipak, formulacija da je promjena moguća „isključivo na neki drugi način” može zvučati kao odbacivanje političkog djelovanja, što bi bilo nepotpuno: Crkva traži i obraćenje osoba i promjenu nepravednih struktura.
concerns: Mogla bi se steći dojam da politički i društveni angažman treba odgoditi dok se ne dogodi prethodno ili potpuno duhovno probuđenje; crkveni nauk ne postavlja obraćenje i rad na pravednijim strukturama kao međusobno isključive alternative, nego traži da se radi na oboma.
magisterium.enrichment: Pio XI. uči da društvenoj obnovi treba prethoditi obnova kršćanskog duha, pa je slika kuće koja se gradi od temelja teološki prikladna. No crkveni nauk istodobno naglašava da obraćenje srca ne uklanja potrebu za promjenom nepravednih struktura i da je političko djelovanje, vođeno evanđeljem i usmjereno općem dobru, dio poziva laika. Stoga duhovno probuđenje može biti temelj političke promjene, ali ne opravdava pasivnost prema nepravdi niti isključivanje političkog djelovanja.

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis that social renewal should be rooted in spiritual and moral transformation is in accordance with Catholic teaching, which highlights the renewal of the Christian spirit as the foundation of social renewal. Nevertheless, the formulation that change is possible "exclusively in some other way" may sound like a rejection of political action, which would be incomplete: the Church calls for both the conversion of persons and the change of unjust structures.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Pius XI teaches that social renewal must be preceded by the renewal of the Christian spirit, so the image of a house being built from the foundation is theologically appropriate. But church teaching simultaneously emphasizes that the conversion of the heart does not eliminate the need to change unjust structures and that political action, guided by the Gospel and directed toward the common good, is part of the vocation of the laity. Therefore, spiritual awakening can be the foundation of political change, but it does not justify passivity toward injustice nor the exclusion of political action.
concerns_en: An impression could be formed that political and social engagement should be postponed until a prior or complete spiritual awakening occurs; church teaching does not set conversion and work on more just structures as mutually exclusive alternatives, but demands work on both.

sections.subtitle_en: "We built the house from the roof": spiritual awakening as a prerequisite for social change
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec explains the metaphor of a house being built from the foundation, not from the roof
sections.content_en:
Based on political experience, Kruno asks whether social change is possible solely through political engagement. Today, Pokupec holds the opposite view: change is, according to his opinion, possible **exclusively in some other way**.

He explains this with a vivid metaphor. All the political and activist options in which he participated, he says, actually **"built the house from the roof instead of from the foundation"**. Today he is convinced that the prerequisite for everything is a spiritual awakening, a spiritual and psychological change among the people as a nation. Political change, he believes, will only follow as a consequence of that, not the other way around, because "a house must be built from the foundation, and not from the top".

sections.subtitle: Učionica kao temelj: od „woke“ gradova do imotskih obitelji s troje i četvero djece
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec uspoređuje kulturu velikih gradova s kulturom koju je vidio u Imotskom
sections.content:
Kruno nastavlja na metaforu i pita kako Pokupec kao vjeroučitelj u učionici gradi „kuću od temelja do krova“. Gost odgovara da iskorištava svaki mogući prostor kako bi **oblikovao „male umove“** na ispravan način i u ispravnoj kulturi.

Putujući Hrvatskom, kaže, uočava velike kulturološke krajnosti. S jedne su strane urbane sredine i veliki gradovi koji se, prema njegovim riječima, „guše u toj woke filozofiji“ i u, kako voli reći, **„leftarskim narativima“**. S druge je strane iskustvo s ovogodišnjeg, kako kaže, poluturističkog boravka u **Imotskom**, gdje je vidio „dijametralno suprotnu“ kulturu:
- dijete se doživljava kao blagoslov,
- pobačaj se uopće ne uzima u obzir kao opcija,
- mladi ljudi u dvadesetima i ranim tridesetima imaju troje ili četvero djece,
- obitelji se grade na zdravim vrijednostima i temeljima.

Kao vjeroučitelj, a radio je, ističe, sa svim uzrastima, od najmanjih do srednjoškolaca, uvijek se trudio usaditi učenicima zdrave vrijednosti. Svjestan je da ne može kontrolirati kako će se one dalje razvijati u njihovim životima. Ipak, zna iz vlastitog iskustva da je i sam postao vjeroučitelj zahvaljujući svom vjeroučitelju iz osnovne škole, čije se posađeno sjeme kasnije razvilo i razgranalo u njegovu životu. Zato, kaže, pokušava učiniti isto što je činio njegov **Stipo Bilić**, kojemu usput upućuje „veliki pozdrav“.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim naukom jer naglašava vrijednost djece, zaštitu nerođenog života i važnost vjerskog odgoja, koji može ostaviti plodove i nakon što učenik napusti učionicu. Ipak, politički obojene oznake za čitave urbane sredine i izraz „oblikovati male umove” traže oprez kako odgoj ne bi zvučao kao ideološko oblikovanje, a složena pastoralna pitanja ne bi bila svedena na stereotipe.
concerns: Izraz „guše u toj woke filozofiji” i „leftarski narativi” široke su, polemičke oznake; bez konkretnog objašnjenja ne pokazuju koje su tvrdnje ili postupci u sukobu s katoličkim naukom, a mogu nepravedno prikazati cijele skupine ljudi.

Pohvala obiteljima s troje ili četvero djece i tvrdnja da se pobačaj ondje ne uzima u obzir mogu biti svjedočanstvo kulture života, ali ne bi ih trebalo tumačiti kao mjerilo svetosti obitelji ili zanemariti potrebu za suosjećajnom podrškom ženama i obiteljima u teškim okolnostima.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk potvrđuje dostojanstvo ljudske osobe od začeća i poziva na zaštitu svakog nerođenog života, pa je pozitivno prikazivanje djeteta kao blagoslova načelno u skladu s crkvenim učenjem. Vjerski odgoj može surađivati s roditeljima u prenošenju vjere i kršćanskih vrijednosti, ali dijete treba odgajati uz poštovanje njegove osobne dostojanstvenosti i slobode, a ne kao predmet oblikovanja.

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is largely aligned with Catholic teaching because it emphasizes the value of children, the protection of unborn life, and the importance of religious education, which can bear fruit even after a student leaves the classroom. Nevertheless, politically colored labels for entire urban environments and the expression "to shape little minds" require caution so that education does not sound like ideological shaping, and complex pastoral issues are not reduced to stereotypes.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching affirms the dignity of the human person from conception and calls for the protection of every unborn life, so presenting a child positively as a blessing is in principle in accordance with Church teaching. Religious education can cooperate with parents in transmitting the faith and Christian values, but a child should be brought up with respect for his or her personal dignity and freedom, not as an object of shaping.
concerns_en: The expressions "choking in that woke philosophy" and "leftard narratives" are broad, polemical labels; without a concrete explanation, they do not show which claims or actions are in conflict with Catholic teaching, and they can unfairly depict entire groups of people.

Praise for families with three or four children and the assertion that abortion is not considered there can be a testimony to the culture of life, but they should not be interpreted as a measure of a family's holiness or ignore the need for compassionate support for women and families in difficult circumstances.

sections.subtitle_en: The classroom as a foundation: from "woke" cities to Imotski families with three and four children
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec compares the culture of large cities with the culture he saw in Imotski
sections.content_en:
Kruno continues with the metaphor and asks how Pokupec, as a religious education teacher in the classroom, builds a "house from the foundation to the roof." The guest replies that he uses every possible space to **shape "little minds"** in the right way and in the right culture.

Traveling through Croatia, he says, he notices great cultural extremes. On one hand are urban environments and large cities that, according to his words, are "choking in that woke philosophy" and in, as he likes to say, **"leftard narratives"**. On the other hand is the experience from this year's, as he says, semi-tourist stay in **Imotski**, where he saw a "diametrically opposite" culture:
- a child is perceived as a blessing,
- abortion is not considered an option at all,
- young people in their twenties and early thirties have three or four children,
- families are built on healthy values and foundations.

As a religious education teacher—and he has worked, he emphasizes, with all age groups, from the youngest to high school students—he has always tried to instill healthy values in the students. He is aware that he cannot control how they will develop further in their lives. Nevertheless, he knows from his own experience that he himself became a religious education teacher thanks to his elementary school religious education teacher, whose planted seed later developed and branched out in his life. That is why, he says, he tries to do the same thing his **Stipo Bilić** did, to whom he sends a "big greeting" in passing.

sections.subtitle: Uhljebnički sustav i škola bez odgoja: zašto je vjeronauk ostao „luksuzna pozicija“
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec govori o nestanku odgojne uloge iz školskih predmeta osim vjeronauka
sections.content:
S obzirom na gotovo dva desetljeća iskustva u obrazovnom sustavu, Kruno pita koji su danas najveći izazovi u školstvu i što bi Pokupec promijenio. Gost izdvaja **dvije stvari**.

**Prva je uhljebnički karakter sustava.** Prema njegovim riječima, školstvo je samim ustrojem „podosta uhljebničko“ jer privlači ljude koji nisu previše motivirani. Posao nudi relativnu ugodu i sigurnost, a plaća je na kraju mjeseca ista, bez obzira na to daje li netko od sebe sto ili deset posto. To smatra negativnim, jer sustav privlači ljude koji traže „ziherašku“ sigurnost.

**Druga je nestanak odgojne uloge.** Kroz godine se, objašnjava, odgojni element izgubio iz većine predmeta, osim iz vjeronauka. Upozorava da ljudi to ne shvaćaju kad se pred izbore otvore priče o vatikanskim ugovorima i micanju vjeronauka iz škola. Kad je on bio dijete, svaki je profesor djelovao i odgojno. Danas je, kaže, nastava u učionici i kurikulumu toliko regulirana da je nastavnik vrlo ograničen.

Vjeronauk je, prema njegovu mišljenju, jedini predmet koji je ostao **odgojno-obrazovni, a ne obrazovno-odgojni**. To naziva „luksuznom pozicijom“ koja vjeroučiteljima još uvijek omogućuje odgojno djelovanje. Kao primjer navodi vlastito djetinjstvo, kada ga je „bez problema u red dovela profesorica iz matematike“, što se danas, kaže, vidi vrlo rijetko. Danas se još samo vjeroučitelji i vjeroučiteljice bave onim što bi Grci nazvali ljepotom duše, dok je sve ostalo, zaključuje, „nekako postalo robotika“.

magisterium.assessment: Naglašavanje odgojne važnosti vjeronauka u skladu je s katoličkim shvaćanjem da obrazovanje treba obuhvatiti cjelovitu osobu, a ne samo prenošenje znanja. Ipak, tvrdnja da je vjeronauk jedini predmet s odgojnom ulogom i da je ostatak škole postao „robotika” pretjerano je općenita te ne odražava crkveni nauk o odgojnoj odgovornosti cijele škole i svih nastavnika.
concerns: Predstavljanje vjeronauka kao jedinog odgojno-obrazovnog predmeta može nepravedno zanemariti odgojnu ulogu drugih nastavnika i školskih predmeta; katoličko shvaćanje škole uključuje razvoj razuma, prosudbe, volje, osjećaja za vrijednosti i pravednog ponašanja.

Opis nastavnika kao sustavno nemotiviranih te škole kao gotovo posve lišene odgoja iznosi široke vrijednosne prosudbe koje se ne mogu utvrditi samo na temelju katoličkog nauka; valja ih razlikovati od crkvenog stava o važnosti odgoja.
Odgojna zadaća vjeroučitelja ne podrazumijeva da oni zamjenjuju roditelje ili monopoliziraju moralni odgoj; Crkva ističe prvenstvo roditelja te potrebu suradnje obitelji i škole.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko shvaćanje škole nadilazi puko podučavanje činjenica: škola treba pomagati učenicima razvijati prosudbu, volju, osjećaj za vrijednosti i pravedno ponašanje, pa je odgoj šira zadaća obrazovne zajednice. Biblijska tradicija povjerava roditeljima posebno mjesto u prenošenju mudrosti i vjere, dok se škola i nastavnici uključuju kao važna pomoć i suradnici u odgoju. Vjeroučitelj ima posebnu odgovornost svjedočiti i predlagati kršćansku poruku, ali pritom poštuje sve učenike i potiče dijalog, a ne isključivost.

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on the educational importance of religious education is in accordance with the Catholic understanding that education should encompass the whole person, and not merely the transmission of knowledge. However, the claim that religious education is the only subject with an educational role and that the rest of the school has become "robotics" is overly generalized and does not reflect Church teaching on the educational responsibility of the entire school and of all teachers.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catholic understanding of school goes beyond the mere teaching of facts: the school should help students develop judgment, will, a sense of values, and just behavior, so upbringing is a broader task of the educational community. The biblical tradition entrusts parents with a special place in transmitting wisdom and faith, while the school and teachers are involved as an important aid and collaborators in upbringing. The religious education teacher has a special responsibility to witness to and propose the Christian message, but in doing so respects all students and encourages dialogue, rather than exclusivity.
concerns_en: Presenting religious education as the only educational-upbringing subject can unjustly neglect the educational role of other teachers and school subjects; the Catholic understanding of school includes the development of reason, judgment, will, a sense of values, and just behavior.

Describing teachers as systematically unmotivated and the school as almost entirely devoid of upbringing puts forward broad value judgments that cannot be determined solely on the basis of Catholic teaching; they should be distinguished from the Church's stance on the importance of upbringing.

The educational task of religious education teachers does not imply that they replace parents or monopolize moral education; the Church emphasizes the primacy of parents and the need for cooperation between family and school.

sections.subtitle_en: A clientelist system and a school without upbringing: why religious education remained a "luxurious position"
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec speaks about the disappearance of the educational role from school subjects other than religious education
sections.content_en:
Considering almost two decades of experience in the educational system, Kruno asks what the greatest challenges in schooling are today and what Pokupec would change. The guest singles out **two things**.

**The first is the clientelist character of the system.** According to his words, schooling is by its very structure "quite clientelist" because it attracts people who are not overly motivated. The job offers relative comfort and security, and the salary at the end of the month is the same, regardless of whether someone gives one hundred or ten percent of themselves. He considers this negative, because the system attracts people who are looking for "play-it-safe" security.

**The second is the disappearance of the educational role.** Over the years, he explains, the educational element has been lost from most subjects, except from religious education. He warns that people do not realize this when stories about the Vatican agreements and removing religious education from schools are opened before elections. When he was a child, every teacher also acted educationally. Today, he says, instruction in the classroom and the curriculum is so regulated that the teacher is very limited.

Religious education is, in his opinion, the only subject that has remained **upbringing-educational, rather than educational-upbringing**. He calls this a "luxurious position" that still enables religious education teachers to act educationally. As an example, he cites his own childhood, when "without any problem a mathematics teacher set him straight," which today, he says, is seen very rarely. Today, only male and female religious education teachers still deal with what the Greeks would call the beauty of the soul, while everything else, he concludes, "has somehow become robotics."

sections.subtitle: „Divljak u redovima“: netipični vjeroučitelj i manjak ratničke energije u Crkvi
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec uspoređuje put svetosti blaženog Merza i Ivana Krstitelja
sections.content:
Kako na njegov aktivizam gledaju kolege vjeroučitelji i svećenici? „Šareno, šareno“, odgovara Pokupec. Prema njegovu iskustvu, ljudi ga ili iznimno vole i odobravaju njegov rad ili ga iznimno ne vole, a sredine nema. To, kaže, razumije.

Sebe opisuje kao **„apsolutno netipičnog vjeroučitelja“**. Tipičnog vjeroučitelja zamišlja kao osobu koja voli monokromatske boje u odjeći, koja je plašljiva, mirna, staložena i „svetački raspoložena“. Takvim se ljudima, kaže, oduvijek divio, jer je njegov karakter potpuno suprotan. Zato mu nije čudno da takve ljude smeta „jedan divljak u njihovim redovima“ poput njega.

Dugo mu je trebalo, priznaje, da shvati kako su **putovi do svetosti različiti** i da je Bog ljude namjerno stvorio različitih karaktera. Put do svetosti može voditi preko blaženog Merza, ali i preko Ivana Krstitelja. „Obojica su Ivani“, dodaje.

Pokupec smatra da Crkvi, kao zajednici vjernika, često nedostaje **muževnije, ratničke energije**. Napominje da ga se ne shvati krivo, ali smatra da je katolička vjera u Hrvatskoj „feminizirana“ i da se poistovjećuje sa „starim bakicama koje okreću krunicu po cijele dane“. Pita gdje je u svemu tome „muški ratnički moment“ i vjeruje da u tom smislu možda čini nešto dobro, što će, kaže, pokazati vrijeme.

Kruno primjećuje da ga upravo zbog toga zovu „kontroverznim vjeroučiteljem“. Pokupec odgovara da je taj naziv došao od novinara, ali da se ustalio. Kruno zaključuje da se „zalijepio“.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak da ljudi različitih karaktera mogu ići vlastitim putom prema svetosti u skladu je s katoličkim naukom o općem pozivu na svetost i različitim Božjim darovima. Ipak, opis vjere kao „feminizirane” i poziv na „muški ratnički moment” ostaju nejasni i mogu neprimjereno povezati kršćanske vrline s jednim spolom ili omalovažiti žensku pobožnost.
concerns: Izraz „feminizirana” može zvučati kao da su žene, starije vjernice ili pobožnost krunice manje vrijedni ili manje prikladni za Crkvu; takav bi zaključak bio u napetosti s naukom da muškarci i žene jednako sudjeluju u posvetnom djelovanju Duha i svjedočenju za Boga.

„Ratnička energija” nije dovoljno objašnjena: ako označava hrabrost, ustrajnost i spremnost na služenje, može biti prihvatljiva slika; ako sugerira agresivnost ili da je svetost prvenstveno muževna, zahtijeva korekciju. Odlomak ne razjašnjava što točno podrazumijeva.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk potvrđuje da su svi vjernici pozvani na svetost, ali da taj poziv ostvaruju vlastitim putem, prema svom životnom staležu i darovima; različiti primjeri svetosti nisu kalup koji svi moraju oponašati. Blaženi Ivan Merz prikazan je kao primjer svetosti oblikovane liturgijom, euharistijom i apostolatom, a ne određenim temperamentom ili rodnim stilom. Zato se hrabrost i duhovna borba mogu vrednovati kao kršćanske kvalitete, ali treba ih razumjeti kao služenje Kristu i bližnjemu, a ne kao suprotnost ženskoj pobožnosti ili mirnijim putovima svetosti.
magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis that people of different characters can follow their own path toward holiness is in accordance with Catholic teaching on the universal call to holiness and the diverse gifts of God. However, describing the faith as “feminized” and calling for a “male warrior moment” remain ambiguous and could inappropriately link Christian virtues to one gender or disparage female piety.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching confirms that all believers are called to holiness, but that they realize that call through their own path, according to their state of life and gifts; different examples of holiness are not a mold that everyone must imitate. Blessed Ivan Merz is presented as an example of holiness shaped by the liturgy, the Eucharist, and the apostolate, rather than by a specific temperament or gendered style. Therefore, courage and spiritual battle can be valued as Christian qualities, but they must be understood as service to Christ and neighbor, and not as an opposition to female piety or quieter paths of holiness.
concerns_en: The term “feminized” can sound as though women, elderly female believers, or the devotion of the Rosary are less valuable or less fitting for the Church; such a conclusion would be in tension with the teaching that men and women participate equally in the sanctifying action of the Spirit and witnessing for God.

“Warrior energy” is not sufficiently explained: if it signifies courage, perseverance, and readiness to serve, it can be an acceptable image; if it suggests aggressiveness or that holiness is primarily masculine, it requires correction. The passage does not clarify what exactly it entails.

sections.subtitle_en: “A savage in the ranks”: an atypical catechist and the lack of warrior energy in the Church
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec compares the path of holiness of Blessed Merz and John the Baptist
sections.content_en:
How do fellow catechists and priests view his activism? “Varied, varied,” Pokupec answers. According to his experience, people either exceptionally love him and approve of his work or exceptionally dislike him, and there is no middle ground. That, he says, he understands.

He describes himself as an **“absolutely atypical catechist”**. He imagines a typical catechist as a person who likes monochromatic colors in clothing, who is timid, calm, composed, and “saintly disposed.” He has always admired such people, he says, because his character is completely the opposite. That is why it is not strange to him that such people are bothered by “a savage in their ranks” like him.

It took him a long time, he admits, to realize that **the paths to holiness are different** and that God intentionally created people with different characters. The path to holiness can lead through Blessed Merz, but also through John the Baptist. “Both are Johns,” he adds.

Pokupec believes that the Church, as a community of believers, often lacks **more masculine, warrior energy**. He notes that he should not be misunderstood, but he believes that the Catholic faith in Croatia is “feminized” and that it is identified with “old grandmothers who turn the Rosary all day long.” He asks where in all of that is the “male warrior moment” and believes that in that sense he might be doing something good, which, he says, time will tell.

Kruno observes that it is precisely because of this that they call him a “controversial catechist.” Pokupec replies that this title came from journalists, but that it took hold. Kruno concludes that it “stuck.”

sections.subtitle: Dječje sudbine koje se ne zaboravljaju i poruka bez zadrške: bez Krista nema spasenja
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec govori o Kristu kao Janjetu, ali i Lavu iz Judina plemena
sections.content:
Kruno pita što se Pokupcu najviše urezalo u pamćenje u radu s djecom. Gost se poziva na zajedničko iskustvo, jer je i Kruno bio profesor: nastavnik najduže pamti najproblematičnije i najbolje učenike. Pokupcu su ipak najviše ostali u sjećanju učenici koji akademski nisu bili ni najbolji ni najlošiji, nego oni čije su ga **životne situacije osobno dotaknule**.

Kao nastavnik, kaže, „nagledaš se svega“, pa i djece kojima je nastavnik u dva školska sata tjedno više otac nego njihovi očevi kod kuće. Sluša se i tragičnih priča koje nijedno dijete ne bi smjelo proživljavati. To ga, priznaje, ne može ostaviti ravnodušnim: ponekad poželi svu tu djecu zagrliti, privinuti k sebi i zaštititi da ih „nitko krivo ni ne pogleda“. Najviše pamti upravo teške i nepravedne dječje sudbine, a u ta mala djetinjstva najviše je i nastojao uložiti sebe.

Na pitanje koju vrijednost najviše želi prenijeti učenicima, odgovara da je to istina da je **Krist spasitelj i kralj**, da je Janje, ali i **Lav iz Judina plemena** te gospodar nad vojskama. Krist, kaže, nije samo očinski nježna figura, „što je Bogu hvala“, nego i pravedna figura koja donosi ratničku energiju i duhovnu pobjedu kakva je ljudima često potrebna.

Pokupec smatra da se danas izgubila iz vida temeljna istina da **bez Krista nema spasenja**. U atmosferi političke korektnosti, kaže, vjernici se boje to i izgovoriti. Društvo u kojemu sve veću ulogu imaju druge religije, ateizam, odnosno antiteizam, i katolička „pristojnost“ dovode do toga da se ta velika istina prešućuje. Zaključuje da je vrijeme da se ona vrati, u ljubavi, ali tako da se svakome „jasno u facu“ kaže da bez Isusa nema spasenja.

magisterium.assessment: Središnja tvrdnja da je Krist jedini Spasitelj u skladu je s katoličkom vjerom i novozavjetnim svjedočanstvom: spasenje dolazi po Kristu, a ne po nekom od njega neovisnom putu. Ipak, način na koji se poruka želi izreći može zvučati grubo, a formulacija ne razjašnjava da i oni koji izričito ne poznaju Krista mogu biti spašeni samo njegovom milošću.
concerns: Izraz „svakome jasno u facu” može ostaviti dojam da je evangelizacija dopuštena bez obzira na poštovanje sugovornika; odlučno svjedočenje treba razlikovati od ponižavanja ili nepotrebne agresivnosti.

Treba pojasniti da „bez Krista nema spasenja” znači da je svako spasenje ostvareno po Kristu, a ne da je nužno svaki spašeni čovjek za života izričito upoznao Krista ili postao katolik. Crkva priznaje mogućnost spasenja onih koji ne poznaju Evanđelje, ali to spasenje i dalje dolazi po Kristovoj milosti, a ne neovisno o njemu.
magisterium.enrichment: Petar ispovijeda da „nema spasenja ni u kome drugom” (Dj 4,12), a Crkva tu tvrdnju razumije kao jedinstveno i univerzalno Kristovo posredništvo, koje ne isključuje mogućnost da njegova milost djeluje i među ljudima koji ga ne poznaju izričito. Zato poštovanje prema pripadnicima drugih religija ne traži prešućivanje Kristova prvenstva, ali ni tvrdnja o njegovoj jedinstvenosti ne opravdava omalovažavanje drugih. Slika Krista kao Jaganjca i Gospodara može povezati njegovu žrtvenu ljubav s kraljevskim autoritetom; naglasak na „ratničkoj energiji” najbolje je razumjeti kao duhovnu pobjedu nad grijehom i smrću, a ne kao poziv na ljudsko nasilje.

citations.document_title: Declaration "Dominus Iesus": On the Unicity and Salvific Universality of Jesus Christ and the Church
citations.document_author: Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith

magisterium.assessment_en: The central claim that Christ is the only Savior is in accordance with the Catholic faith and New Testament witness: salvation comes through Christ, and not through any path independent of him. Nevertheless, the manner in which the message is intended to be stated may sound harsh, and the formulation does not clarify that even those who do not explicitly know Christ can be saved only by his grace.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Peter confesses that "there is salvation in no one else" (Acts 4:12), and the Church understands this claim as Christ's unique and universal mediation, which does not exclude the possibility that his grace works also among people who do not know him explicitly. Therefore, respect toward members of other religions does not require keeping silent about Christ's primacy, but neither does the claim of his uniqueness justify disparaging others. The image of Christ as the Lamb and the Lord can connect his sacrificial love with royal authority; the emphasis on "warrior energy" is best understood as a spiritual victory over sin and death, rather than a call to human violence.
concerns_en: The expression "clearly to everyone's face" can leave the impression that evangelization is permissible without regard for respect for the interlocutor; resolute witnessing should be distinguished from humiliation or unnecessary aggressiveness.

It should be clarified that "without Christ there is no salvation" means that all salvation is accomplished through Christ, not that every saved person necessarily explicitly came to know Christ or became Catholic during life. The Church recognizes the possibility of salvation for those who do not know the Gospel, but that salvation still comes through the grace of Christ, and not independently of him.

sections.subtitle_en: Children's destinies that are not forgotten and an unreserved message: without Christ there is no salvation
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec speaks about Christ as the Lamb, but also the Lion of the tribe of Judah
sections.content_en:
Kruno asks what was most etched into Pokupec's memory in working with children. The guest refers to a shared experience, because Kruno was also a teacher: a teacher remembers the most problematic and the best students the longest. To Pokupec, however, the students who remained most in his memory were those who academically were neither the best nor the worst, but those whose **life situations touched him personally**.

As a teacher, he says, "you see it all", including children to whom a teacher in two class hours a week is more of a father than their fathers at home. One also hears tragic stories that no child should have to go through. This, he admits, cannot leave him indifferent: sometimes he wishes to hug all those children, hold them close to himself, and protect them so that "no one even looks at them the wrong way". What he remembers most are precisely the difficult and unjust children's destinies, and into those little childhoods he tried most to invest himself.

To the question of which value he most wants to impart to students, he replies that it is the truth that **Christ is savior and king**, that he is the Lamb, but also the **Lion of the tribe of Judah** and Lord of hosts. Christ, he says, is not only a fatherly gentle figure, "which is thank God", but also a just figure who brings warrior energy and spiritual victory of the kind that people often need.

Pokupec believes that today the fundamental truth that **without Christ there is no salvation** has been lost from sight. In an atmosphere of political correctness, he says, believers are afraid even to utter it. A society in which other religions, atheism, that is, antitheism, and Catholic "politeness" play an increasing role leads to this great truth being kept silent. He concludes that it is time for it to return, in love, but in such a way that everyone is told "clearly to their face" that without Jesus there is no salvation.
entities_en: Lion of the tribe of Judah

sections.subtitle: Najveća prijetnja djeci nisu ekrani, nego nezainteresirani roditelji
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec objašnjava da je najveća prijetnja djeci nepažnja roditelja
sections.content:
Kruno podsjeća da je Pokupec otac dvoje djece, a gost dodaje da će ih, ako Bog da, biti još. Voditelj spominje i njegovu „duhovnu djecu“, učenike kojima je predavao i predaje. Pita što je danas najveća prijetnja djeci i njihovu nevinom djetinjstvu.

Odgovor je jasan: **nepažnja roditelja**, „da ne kažem nezainteresiranost“. Pokupec pritom svjesno izbjegava uobičajenu priču o ekranima. Ekran je, kaže, sredstvo kao i sve drugo, a sve što ljudi danas imaju na raspolaganju može biti blagoslov ili prokletstvo, ovisno o tome kako se koristi.

Roditelji, smatra, često griješe jer nisu svjesno uključeni u život djece, nego djeca postaju dio njihove rutine. Ne posvećuju im dovoljno vremena, pažnje i energije, nego se daju odvući vlastitim problemima, rutinama i ekranima, pa se gubi mnogo potencijala.

Prema njegovu iskustvu, gotovo će svako dijete dati onoliko koliko se od njega traži, a današnji se roditelji često boje mnogo tražiti. On sam, kaže, uz puno ljubavi mnogo i zahtijeva od svoje djece, a sve su ljestvice visoko postavljene. Čak i ako ih ne dosegnu, vrijedi izreka: **„pucaj na Mjesec, pa ćeš završiti među zvijezdama“**. Kao roditelj nastoji biti svjesno uključen u sve što djeca rade, imati nadzor nad time i odgajati ih u vrijednostima koje obitelj živi i za koje vjeruje da će im omogućiti kvalitetan život. Zaključuje da u životu svakog djeteta treba više roditeljske koncentracije i pozornosti.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na roditelji trebaju djeci posvetiti vrijeme, pažnju i odgovoran odgoj u obiteljskim vrijednostima dobro se slaže s katoličkim shvaćanjem roditeljske zadaće i potrebe za budnošću. Ispravno je i ne svoditi problem na same ekrane, no njihova uporaba ipak traži razborito usmjeravanje i nadzor, a visoka očekivanja moraju ostati razmjerna djetetovim mogućnostima.
concerns: Izreka o visokim ljestvicama može biti korisna kao poticaj, ali bez naglaska na strpljivosti i mjeri mogla bi se shvatiti kao opravdanje pretjeranih zahtjeva; kršćanski odgoj uključuje disciplinu, ali roditelji ne smiju djecu obeshrabriti ili ih pretjerano opterećivati.

Ekrani nisu sami po sebi nužno zlo, ali tvrdnju da je ekran samo sredstvo treba dopuniti upozorenjem da roditelji trebaju pratiti sadržaj i dobnu primjerenost, jer je budnost potrebna i u odnosu na elektroničke medije.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk roditeljsku odgovornost vidi kao prvo i nezamjenjivo mjesto odgoja: ona uključuje svjedočanstvo ljubavi i kreposti, poučavanje i razborito ispravljanje, a ne samo nadzor ili postavljanje ciljeva. Sveto pismo potiče roditelje da djecu odgajaju u Gospodinovoj stezi i pouci, ali istodobno upozorava da ih ne razdražuju ni obeshrabruju; zato zahtjevnost treba biti prožeta ljubavlju, strpljivošću i poštovanjem djetetova razvoja.

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis that parents need to dedicate time, attention, and responsible upbringing in family values to children accords well with the Catholic understanding of the parental task and the need for vigilance. It is also correct not to reduce the problem merely to screens themselves, but their use nonetheless requires prudent guidance and supervision, and high expectations must remain proportionate to the child's abilities.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching sees parental responsibility as the primary and irreplaceable place of upbringing: it includes the witness of love and virtue, instruction, and prudent correction, not just supervision or setting goals. Sacred Scripture encourages parents to raise children in the discipline and instruction of the Lord, but at the same time warns not to provoke or discourage them; therefore, demandingness should be imbued with love, patience, and respect for the child's development.
concerns_en: The saying about high bars can be useful as an encouragement, but without an emphasis on patience and moderation it could be understood as a justification for excessive demands; Christian upbringing includes discipline, but parents must not discourage their children or burden them excessively.

Screens are not in themselves necessarily an evil, but the claim that a screen is merely a tool should be supplemented with the warning that parents need to monitor content and age appropriateness, because vigilance is also necessary regarding electronic media.

sections.subtitle_en: The greatest threat to children is not screens, but uninterested parents
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec explains that the greatest threat to children is parental inattention
sections.content_en:
Kruno recalls that Pokupec is a father of two children, and the guest adds that, God willing, there will be more. The host also mentions his “spiritual children,” students he has taught and continues to teach. He asks what today is the greatest threat to children and their innocent childhood.

The answer is clear: **parental inattention**, “not to say disinterest.” In doing so, Pokupec consciously avoids the usual talk about screens. A screen is, he says, a tool like anything else, and everything people have at their disposal today can be a blessing or a curse, depending on how it is used.

Parents, he believes, often make a mistake because they are not consciously involved in their children's lives, but children become part of their routine. They do not dedicate enough time, attention, and energy to them, but allow themselves to be dragged away by their own problems, routines, and screens, so a lot of potential is lost.

According to his experience, almost every child will give as much as is demanded of them, and today's parents are often afraid to demand much. He himself, he says, with much love also demands a lot from his children, and all the bars are set high. Even if they do not reach them, the saying holds true: **“shoot for the Moon, and you will end up among the stars”**. As a parent, he strives to be consciously involved in everything the children do, to have supervision over it, and to raise them in the values the family lives and which he believes will enable them to have a quality life. He concludes that in the life of every child, more parental concentration and attention is needed.

sections.subtitle: Dva lica očinske odsutnosti: posao u inozemstvu i bijeg u kladionice
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec govori o očevima koji vrijeme troše na kladionice, alkohol i igrice
sections.content:
Kruno zatim usmjerava razgovor na ulogu oca i pita gdje očevi najviše griješe. Pokupec razlikuje dvije situacije, jednu opravdanu i jednu neopravdanu.

**Prva situacija** odnosi se na očeve koji su zbog posla odsutni iz života svoje djece. Teško je to, kaže, prosuđivati, a kamoli osuđivati. U svojim je učionicama znao imati i do **30 posto učenika** čiji su očevi radili negdje u inozemstvu i nisu bili prisutni jer su pokušavali „staviti kruh na stol“. To ne može osuditi i naziva to „nužnim zlom“.

**Druga situacija** su biološki očevi koje, kako kaže, ne bi ni nazvao očevima u pravom smislu riječi. Oni su se predali hobijima, zadovoljstvima i vlastitim interesima, pa im vrijeme odlazi na:
- kladionice,
- alkohol,
- igrice,
- „gluposti“.

Djeca su tada prepuštena sama sebi jer nedostaje očinska uloga koja, prema Pokupcu, mora značiti **vodstvo, sigurnost i prisutnost**.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na očinskoj prisutnosti, brizi i odgovornosti u skladu je s katoličkim naukom, koji očevu odsutnost prepoznaje kao ozbiljan gubitak za obiteljski život i odgoj djece. Razlikovanje između odsutnosti radi uzdržavanja obitelji i zanemarivanja djece zbog vlastitih interesa razborito je, ali izrazi poput „nužno zlo” i nijekanje da je zanemarujući roditelj „otac u pravom smislu” traže dodatno pojašnjenje.
concerns: Odsutnost zbog rada u inozemstvu ne treba automatski nazivati „nužnim zlom”: rad može biti odgovorno služenje obitelji, premda dugotrajna fizička odsutnost može otežati očinsku blizinu i odgoj.

Kladionice, alkohol i zanemarivanje obitelji mogu biti ozbiljno štetni, ali općenito navođenje igrica ili „gluposti” ne bi smjelo sugerirati da su svaka razonoda ili videoigre same po sebi moralno pogrešne; bitno je vodi li ponašanje u neodgovorno zanemarivanje obitelji.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko razumijevanje očinstva povezuje uzdržavanje obitelji s blizinom supruzi i djeci: rad ne bi smio trajno raspršiti obiteljski život, a očeva prisutnost znači vodstvo i ljubav, ne kontrolu. Sveto pismo i crkveno učenje upozoravaju na štetu koju djeca trpe kad su prepuštena sama sebi, a istodobno nude sliku milosrdnog oca koji strpljivo čeka povratak sina. Zato procjena očeva ponašanja treba razlikovati okolnosti koje ograničavaju njegovu prisutnost od slobodnog i trajnog zanemarivanja roditeljske dužnosti.

citations.document_title: General Audience of 28 January 2015: The family - 3. The father (First part)
General Audience of 4 February 2015: The family - 3. The father (Second part)

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on paternal presence, care, and responsibility is in accordance with Catholic teaching, which recognizes a father's absence as a serious loss for family life and the upbringing of children. Distinguishing between absence for the sake of supporting the family and neglecting children due to personal interests is prudent, but expressions such as "necessary evil" and denying that a neglectful parent is a "father in the true sense" require additional clarification.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catholic understanding of fatherhood connects supporting the family with closeness to one's wife and children: work should not permanently scatter family life, and a father's presence means leadership and love, not control. Sacred Scripture and Church teaching warn of the harm children suffer when they are left to themselves, while at the same time offering the image of the merciful father who patiently awaits the return of his son. Therefore, the assessment of a father's behavior must distinguish circumstances that limit his presence from a free and enduring neglect of parental duty.
concerns_en: Absence due to work abroad should not automatically be called a "necessary evil": work can be responsible service to the family, although prolonged physical absence can make paternal closeness and upbringing difficult.

Betting shops, alcohol, and neglect of the family can be seriously harmful, but generally citing video games or "foolish things" should not suggest that all leisure or video games are in themselves morally wrong; what matters is whether the behavior leads to irresponsible neglect of the family.

sections.subtitle_en: Two faces of paternal absence: work abroad and fleeing to betting shops
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec speaks about fathers who spend time on betting shops, alcohol, and video games
sections.content_en:
Kruno then directs the conversation to the role of the father and asks where fathers make the most mistakes. Pokupec distinguishes between two situations, one justified and one unjustified.

**The first situation** relates to fathers who, because of work, are absent from the lives of their children. It is difficult, he says, to judge this, let alone condemn it. In his classrooms, he used to have up to **30 percent of students** whose fathers worked somewhere abroad and were not present because they were trying to "put bread on the table." He cannot condemn that and calls it a "necessary evil."

**The second situation** involves biological fathers whom, as he says, he would not even call fathers in the true sense of the word. They have surrendered themselves to hobbies, pleasures, and their own interests, so their time goes to:
- betting shops,
- alcohol,
- video games,
- "foolish things."

Children are then left to themselves because the paternal role is missing, which, according to Pokupec, must mean **leadership, security, and presence**.

sections.subtitle: Radikalni feminizam kao dvosjekli mač: „najveći krivac za pobačaj su muškarci“
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec tvrdi da su muškarci najveći krivci za pobačaj
sections.content:
Kruno iznosi mišljenje da su se muškarci danas povukli zbog spomenutih procesa, ali i zbog radikalnog feminizma, jer se boje da će ih drugi smatrati toksičnima ili nametljivima. Pita Pokupca kako gleda na današnji radikalni feminizam, koji, prema voditeljevim riječima, nema veze s izvornim feminizmom.

Pokupec ga naziva **dvosjeklim mačem**. S jedne strane postoji objektivna situacija: kada muškarac ne ispunjava svoju ulogu supruga i oca, žena mora, „htjela-ne htjela“, preuzeti dio te uloge. Prema ženama u takvim okolnostima osjeća veliko suosjećanje. Kada je muškarac, kako se grubo izražava, „bitanga“, žena mora biti i majka i otac jer ju na to prisiljava njegovo ponašanje. Krivnju u tom slučaju s punom odgovornošću pripisuje muškarcu.

Posebno to vrijedi za pitanje pobačaja. **„Za mene najveći krivac za pobačaj danas u svijetu su muškarci“**, ističe Pokupec. Kada muškarac ispunjava ulogu zaštitnika i oslonca, rijetko će se koja žena odlučiti za pobačaj, a to, kaže, i on i Kruno znaju iz osobnog iskustva.

S druge strane postoji situacija u kojoj su se muškarci, u kontekstu radikalnog feminizma, jednostavno dali zastrašiti i povukli se, što nisu smjeli učiniti. Pokupec smatra da su i vjernici možda preozbiljno shvatili feminizam i dali mu previše prostora. Da su ga na vrijeme, kako kaže, „sprdali i ismijali onako kako je trebalo“, vjerojatno se danas ne bi našli u ovoj situaciji.

Zaključuje da svatko tko je proučavao feminizam ili objektivno promatra odnose muškarca i žene shvaća da su oni od pamtivijeka bili **tim**, koji je zajedno gradio život, dom i ispunjavao svoje uloge. U braku, osobito kršćanskom, nema mjesta borbi za dominaciju. Muž i žena tu su da se nadopunjuju, ispunjavaju potrebe jedno drugoga, služe jedno drugome u ljubavi i zajedno podižu dom i djecu. Natjecanje između njih naziva „kratkovidnim i blesavim“ poimanjem odnosa muškarca i žene.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na odgovornosti muškarca, uzajamnom služenju i braku bez borbe za dominaciju uglavnom je sukladan kršćanskom razumijevanju bračne ljubavi, ali tvrdnja da su muškarci „najveći krivac” za pobačaj preširoka je i nije potkrijepljena ponuđenim izvorima. Omalovažavanje feminizma ismijavanjem također ne razlikuje pravedno promicanje dostojanstva žena od pojedinih ideologija koje mogu biti kritizirane.
concerns: Odgovornost muškaraca za napuštanje obiteljskih dužnosti jest stvarna, no proglašavanje muškaraca najvećim krivcima za pobačaj generalizira i može prikriti konkretne razlike u odgovornosti i okolnostima pojedinih slučajeva; dostupni izvori ne potvrđuju takvu tvrdnju.

Poziv na ismijavanje feminizma ne razlikuje različite pokrete i ideje, a može zanemariti legitimno zalaganje za jednako ljudsko dostojanstvo i pravednost žena. Crkveno učenje izričito priznaje feminizam koji ne negira majčinstvo.

Opis muškarca kao zaštitnika može biti prihvatljiv ako znači velikodušnu skrb i odgovornost, mutta ne smije se razumjeti kao da je žena pasivna ili joj nedostaje jednako dostojanstvo i sposobnost djelovanja.
magisterium.enrichment: Biblijska slika muškarca i žene govori o zajedništvu osoba jednake ljudske vrijednosti, a ne o nadmetanju: Postanak prikazuje njihovu uzajamnost, dok Ef 5 treba čitati u svjetlu uzajamnog podlaganja u strahu Kristovu i Kristove samopredajne ljubavi. Crkva pritom osuđuje odnos spolova kao sukob i zagovara mir, uzajamnu ljubav i ravnopravno dostojanstvo, ali istodobno priznaje valjanost feminizma koji ne zahtijeva uniformnost niti poriče majčinstvo. Stoga se odgovornost muškaraca za dobrobit supruge i djece može snažno istaknuti, ali bez svođenja složenog pitanja pobačaja na jednu skupinu ili omalovažavanja osoba s kojima se ne slažemo.
