magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on the responsibility of the man, mutual service, and marriage without a struggle for dominance is largely in accordance with the Christian understanding of marital love, but the claim that men are the “greatest culprit” for abortion is overly broad and is not supported by the provided sources. Belittling feminism through ridicule also fails to distinguish the just promotion of the dignity of women from specific ideologies that may be criticized.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The biblical image of man and woman speaks of a communion of persons of equal human worth, and not of competition: Genesis shows their mutuality, while Eph 5 should be read in the light of mutual submission in the fear of Christ and Christ's self-giving love. In doing so, the Church condemns the relationship between the sexes as conflict and advocates for peace, mutual love, and equal dignity, but at the same time recognizes the validity of a feminism that does not demand uniformity nor deny motherhood. Therefore, the responsibility of men for the well-being of the wife and children can be strongly emphasized, but without reducing the complex issue of abortion to a single group or belittling persons with whom we disagree.
concerns_en: The responsibility of men for abandoning family duties is real, but declaring men to be the greatest culprits for abortion generalizes and can obscure concrete differences in responsibility and the circumstances of individual cases; available sources do not confirm such a claim.

The call to ridicule feminism does not distinguish between different movements and ideas, and can neglect the legitimate advocacy for equal human dignity and justice for women. Church teaching explicitly recognizes a feminism that does not negate motherhood.
Describing the man as a protector can be acceptable if it means generous care and responsibility, but it must not be understood as if the woman were passive or lacked equal dignity and agency.

sections.subtitle_en: Radical feminism as a double-edged sword: “the greatest culprit for abortion is men”
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec claims that men are the greatest culprits for abortion
sections.content_en:
Kruno expresses the opinion that men today have withdrawn because of the mentioned processes, but also because of radical feminism, because they fear that others will consider them toxic or intrusive. He asks Pokupec how he views today's radical feminism, which, according to the host's words, has nothing to do with original feminism.

Pokupec calls it a **double-edged sword**. On the one hand, there is an objective situation: when a man does not fulfill his role as a husband and father, a woman must, “willy-nilly”, take over part of that role. Toward women in such circumstances, he feels great compassion. When a man is, as he puts it crudely, a “scoundrel”, a woman must be both mother and father because his behavior forces her to do so. The blame in that case he attributes to the man with full responsibility.

This is especially true for the issue of abortion. **“For me, the greatest culprit for abortion in the world today is men”**, Pokupec points out. When a man fulfills the role of protector and support, rarely will any woman decide on an abortion, and that, he says, both he and Kruno know from personal experience.

On the other hand, there is a situation in which men, in the context of radical feminism, simply allowed themselves to be intimidated and withdrew, which they should not have done. Pokupec considers that believers, too, perhaps took feminism too seriously and gave it too much space. Had they in time, as he says, “mocked and ridiculed it the way it should have been”, they probably would not find themselves in this situation today.

He concludes that anyone who has studied feminism or objectively observes the relationship between a man and a woman understands that from time immemorial they were a **team**, which built a life and a home together and fulfilled their roles. In marriage, especially Christian marriage, there is no place for a struggle for dominance. Husband and wife are there to complement each other, fulfill each other's needs, serve each other in love, and together raise a home and children. He calls competition between them a “short-sighted and silly” conception of the relationship between man and woman.

sections.subtitle: Molitelji i bubnjari na Trgu: mediji, dezinformacije i duhovni autoritet u obitelji
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec objašnjava razliku između fizičkog i duhovnog autoriteta u obitelji
sections.content:
Kruno se nadovezuje na krizu muževnosti, pa i ženstvenosti, i navodi kao primjer prve subote na Trgu, gdje ponizni muškarci kleče i mole da budu bolji muževi i očevi. S druge strane, kaže, stoje pretežno žene koje zagovaraju svoja prava, ne razumiju zašto molitelji mole i ne vjeruju u molitvu, ali osjećaju potrebu prosvjedovati i lijepiti im etikete.

Pokupec smatra da su ljudi koji na suprotnoj strani „bubnjaju i vrište i viču i pjena im ide na usta“ ponajprije **zavedeni i dezinformirani** medijima i novinarima. Današnje mainstream medije naziva „najvećom polugom demoniziranosti i zla“, većom od politike i, kako kaže, „oprostiš“, od prostitucije. Smatra da mediji imaju nezamislivu moć da od sveca naprave „najveće dno“ i obrnuto, a informacije koje iz njih dolaze opisuje kao „terorističke“.

Višekratno je, kaže, javno pokušavao upozoriti na razliku između molitve za **fizički autoritet** u obitelji, što, prema njegovu mišljenju, prosvjednici pripisuju moliteljima, i **duhovnog autoriteta**, koji je nešto dijametralno suprotno. Da bi muškarac bio duhovni autoritet u obitelji, objašnjava, mora prije svega biti ponizan i spreman služiti. To nema nikakve veze s autoritetom kakvim ga zamišljaju prosvjednici.

Pokupec podržava molitvena okupljanja na trgovima diljem Hrvatske jer ona muškarcima poručuju: **ostavi se birtije, kladionice i gluposti, posveti se svojoj ženi, djeci i obitelji**. Zato smatra da bi ih svaka feministica, kako se izražava, „sa tri sive stanice u glavi“ trebala prva podržati. Dodaje i nešto što se, prema njegovu mišljenju, u medijima često previdi: prema njegovim zapažanjima, prvim subotama sve se više žena pridružuje muškarcima na Trgu.

Priznaje da kod prosvjednika vjerojatno postoji i politički utjecaj, ali smatra da su „bubnjari“, „zelenokosi i ljubičastokosi“ ponajprije zavedeni. Kada bi u dobroj namjeri pristali na dijalog, molitelji bi im, uvjeren je, brzo objasnili da su im ciljevi zapravo isti. Muškarac koji je duhovni autoritet u obitelji, kaže, „najveći je blagoslov za ženu u toj obitelji“.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na muževljeva uloga u obitelji treba biti ponizno služenje i odgovornost za dobro žene i djece uglavnom je sukladan katoličkom shvaćanju braka, ali se ta dobra misao iznosi uz omalovažavanje žena i prosvjednika te neutemeljene generalizacije o medijima. Takva retorika slabi poziv na dijalog i međusobno poštovanje, pa odlomak jest djelomično, ali ne potpuno usklađen s kršćanskom porukom.
concerns: Izraz „sa tri sive stanice u glavi“ vrijeđa žene koje se ne slažu s govornikom i ne odgovara poštovanju dostojanstva svake osobe; crkveni nauk izričito odbacuje shvaćanje odnosa muškaraca i žena kao sukoba te ističe jednako dostojanstvo i borbu protiv nepravedne diskriminacije.

Opisivanje protivnika kao zavedenih, uz tvrdnje o medijima kao „najvećoj poluzi demoniziranosti i zla“ i njihovih informacija kao „terorističkih“, iznosi široke optužbe bez potkrepe u odlomku. Takva demonizirajuća generalizacija može otežati istinoljubiv i dobronamjeran dijalog.

Razlikovanje fizičkog i duhovnog autoriteta ostaje nedovoljno razjašnjeno: kršćansko vodstvo u braku ne bi se smjelo razumjeti kao nadmoć ili jednostrana vlast, nego kao odgovornost za dobrobit drugoga i uzajamna podložnost u Kristu.
Tvrdnja da bi molitelji brzo pokazali kako su ciljevi dviju strana zapravo isti predstavljena je kao pretpostavka, a ne kao zaključak potkrijepljen dijalogom ili dokazima.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički naglasak na muževljevoj odgovornosti ima smisla kada se razumije kao velikodušno predanje obitelji, a ne kao ovlast da se supruga podredi: Ivan Pavao II. opisuje muževu muževnost kao povjeravanje sebe ženi i djeci te odgovornost za njihovu duhovnu i materijalnu dobrobit. Povezano s Pavlovim pozivom na „uzajamnu podložnost iz poštovanja prema Kristu“ (Ef 5,21), bračno vodstvo treba tumačiti u okviru uzajamnog služenja i zajedničke odgovornosti. Vjernost takvom idealu uključuje i poštovanje žena koje prosvjeduju, pažljivo razlikovanje činjenica od pretpostavki te razgovor bez vrijeđanja.

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on the husband's role in the family needing to be humble service and responsibility for the good of his wife and children is largely consistent with the Catholic understanding of marriage, but this good thought is presented alongside the belittling of women and protesters as well as unsubstantiated generalizations about the media. Such rhetoric weakens the call to dialogue and mutual respect, so the passage is partially, but not completely aligned with the Christian message.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catholic emphasis on the husband's responsibility makes sense when understood as a generous self-giving to the family, and not as an authority to subjugate the wife: John Paul II describes a husband's masculinity as entrusting himself to his wife and children and responsibility for their spiritual and material well-being. Linked to Paul's call for "mutual submission out of reverence for Christ" (Eph 5:21), marital leadership should be interpreted within the framework of mutual service and shared responsibility. Fidelity to such an ideal also includes respect for the women who protest, careful distinction of facts from assumptions, and conversation without insults.
concerns_en: The phrase "with three gray cells in her head" insults women who disagree with the speaker and does not correspond to respect for the dignity of every person; church teaching explicitly rejects understanding the relationship between men and women as a conflict and emphasizes equal dignity and the struggle against unjust discrimination.

Describing opponents as misled, along with claims about the media as "the greatest lever of demonization and evil" and their information as "terroristic," puts forward broad accusations without substantiation in the passage. Such a demonizing generalization can hinder truthful and well-intentioned dialogue.

The distinction between physical and spiritual authority remains insufficiently clarified: Christian leadership in marriage should not be understood as superiority or unilateral power, but rather as responsibility for the well-being of the other and mutual submission in Christ.
The claim that the prayer warriors would quickly show that the goals of the two sides are actually the same is presented as an assumption, not as a conclusion substantiated by dialogue or evidence.

sections.subtitle_en: Prayers and drummers on the Square: media, disinformation, and spiritual authority in the family
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec explains the difference between physical and spiritual authority in the family
sections.content_en:
Kruno follows up on the crisis of masculinity, and even femininity, and cites as an example the first Saturdays on the Square, where humble men kneel and pray to be better husbands and fathers. On the other side, he says, stand predominantly women who advocate for their rights, do not understand why the prayer warriors pray and do not believe in prayer, but feel the need to protest and stick labels on them.

Pokupec considers that the people on the opposing side who "drum and scream and shout and foam at the mouth" are above all **misled and misinformed** by the media and journalists. He calls today's mainstream media "the greatest lever of demonization and evil," greater than politics and, as he says, "pardon me," than prostitution. He believes that the media have an unimaginable power to make the "lowest scum" out of a saint and vice versa, and he describes the information coming from them as "terroristic."

He says he has repeatedly tried to warn publicly of the difference between praying for **physical authority** in the family, which, in his opinion, the protesters attribute to the prayer warriors, and **spiritual authority**, which is something diametrically opposed. For a man to be a spiritual authority in the family, he explains, he must first of all be humble and ready to serve. That has nothing to do with authority as the protesters imagine it.

Pokupec supports prayer gatherings in squares across Croatia because they send a message to men: **leave the tavern, the betting shop, and nonsense, dedicate yourself to your wife, children, and family**. That is why he believes that every feminist, as he puts it, "with three gray cells in her head" should be the first to support them. He also adds something that, in his opinion, is often overlooked in the media: according to his observations, on the first Saturdays more and more women are joining the men on the Square.

He admits that there is probably political influence among the protesters as well, but he believes that the "drummers," the "green-haired and purple-haired," are above all misled. If they were to agree in good faith to a dialogue, the prayer warriors, he is convinced, would quickly explain to them that their goals are actually the same. A man who is a spiritual authority in the family, he says, is "the greatest blessing for a woman in that family."

sections.subtitle: „Nemamo hrvatsku ljevicu, nego ljevicu u Hrvatskoj“
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec objašnjava svoju razliku između hrvatske ljevice i ljevice u Hrvatskoj
sections.content:
Kruno primjećuje da strana preko puta molitelja muževnost doživljava kao prijetnju, možda zbog neugodnih iskustava iz djetinjstva ili odsutnosti uzornog oca, čime se razgovor vraća na krizu očinstva. Iznosi dojam da ta strana želi **„eliminirati oca iz jednadžbe obitelji“**, što se, prema njegovu mišljenju, sustavno događa posljednjih stotinu do dvjesto godina. Ako se ukloni muškarac, obitelj se urušava, a tada država ili bilo tko drugi može s djecom, ženom i obitelji činiti što želi. Pokupec se slaže: „Tako je, nema zaštite.“

Neistomišljenicima Pokupec poručuje dvije stvari. Prva: **vlastite traume ne mogu se izliječiti produbljivanjem trauma drugih**, to nikada nije funkcioniralo niti će. Druga: oni koji vjeruju da muškarci svijetu nisu potrebni, kaže uz dozu ironije, neka pričekaju prvi nestanak struje ili prve veće rupe na cesti.

Feminizam i „ljevičarenje“ općenito naziva neozbiljnom i kratkovidnom političkom i društvenom ideologijom, utemeljenom na parolama koje na prvu dobro zvuče, ali nemaju smisla čim se o njima dublje promisli. Ipak, kaže da može razumjeti idealističnog ljevičara u srednjoj školi ili na fakultetu, kojeg vodi srce i mladenački entuzijazam, što je pozitivno ako je dobro usmjereno.

Problem Hrvatske, prema njegovim riječima, jest to što **nema hrvatsku ljevicu, nego ljevicu u Hrvatskoj**. Hrvatska bi se ljevica, prema tradicionalnoj podjeli političkih uloga, zalagala za hrvatskog radnika, umirovljenika, osobu s invaliditetom i napušteno dijete. Ljevica u Hrvatskoj, kaže, služi drugim interesima, globalističkima, „zastarjelima, jugonacionalističkima“ ili nekim trećima. Ne želi, dodaje, ulaziti u „famozne teorije zavjere“ o Sorosu i masoneriji. Kada ljevica služi interesima koji su bilo čiji osim hrvatskih, dijalog je, smatra, teško ostvariti jer dvije strane nemaju u srcu dobrobit istih ljudi. Jedni žele raditi za Hrvatsku i ljude u njoj, a drugi, zaključuje, služe tuđim interesima, „svjesno ili nesvjesno“.

magisterium.assessment: Naglašavanje važne i nezamjenjive uloge oca u obitelji uglavnom je u skladu s katoličkim naukom, ali odlomak miješa tu istinu s nedokazanim političkim pripisivanjem tuđih motiva i općim omalovažavanjem feminizma i ljevice. Takvo uopćavanje nije samo po sebi izravna proturječnost nauku, ali može zamagliti zahtjev za pravednim prosuđivanjem i poštovanjem osoba te nije uravnoteženo crkvenim učenjem o jednakom dostojanstvu žene i muškarca.
concerns: Tvrdnje da određena politička strana želi ukloniti oca, služi tuđim interesima ili djeluje radi slabljenja obitelji predstavljene su kao široke procjene, bez potpore u navedenim katoličkim izvorima. Katolički nauk opravdava obranu obitelji, ali ne potvrđuje automatski takva pripisivanja namjera.
Feminizam se opisuje kao neozbiljna i kratkovidna ideologija općenito, dok Amoris laetitia izričito prihvaća feminizam koji ne traži uniformnost niti niječe majčinstvo.

Izjava da bi uklanjanje muškarca srušilo obitelj može pretjerano svesti zaštitu obitelji na mušku prisutnost. Crkva naučava posebnu važnost oca, ali i jednako dostojanstvo žene, zajedničku roditeljsku odgovornost te upozorava da i opresivna očinska prisutnost može štetiti obiteljskim odnosima.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveni nauk doista naglašava da je očeva uloga u obitelji jedinstveno važna: otac je pozvan biti prisutan, sudjelovati u odgoju i voljeti obitelj velikodušno, a ne kontrolirajuće. Istodobno, muž treba poštovati jednako dostojanstvo supruge, a majka i otac zajednički doprinose obiteljskom životu; stoga obrana očinstva ne bi trebala postati omalovažavanje žena ili političkih protivnika.
magisterium.assessment_en: Emphasizing the important and irreplaceable role of the father in the family is largely in accordance with Catholic teaching, but the passage mixes this truth with unproven political attributions of others' motives and a general disparagement of feminism and the left. Such generalization is not in itself a direct contradiction of doctrine, but it can obscure the requirement for just judgment and respect for persons, and it is not balanced by Church teaching on the equal dignity of woman and man.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching indeed emphasizes that the father's role in the family is uniquely important: the father is called to be present, to participate in upbringing, and to love the family generously, not in a controlling way. At the same time, the husband should respect the equal dignity of the wife, and the mother and father jointly contribute to family life; therefore, the defense of fatherhood should not become a disparagement of women or political opponents.
concerns_en: Claims that a particular political side wants to remove the father, serves others' interests, or acts to weaken the family are presented as broad assessments, without support in the cited Catholic sources. Catholic teaching justifies the defense of the family, but does not automatically confirm such attributions of intentions.
Feminism is described as an unserious and short-sighted ideology in general, whereas Amoris laetitia explicitly accepts a feminism that does not demand uniformity nor deny motherhood.

The statement that removing the man would collapse the family may excessively reduce the protection of the family to male presence. The Church teaches the special importance of the father, but also the equal dignity of woman, shared parental responsibility, and warns that an oppressive fatherly presence can also harm family relationships.

sections.subtitle_en: "We do not have a Croatian left, but a left in Croatia"
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec explains his distinction between the Croatian left and the left in Croatia
sections.content_en:
Kruno observes that the side across from those praying perceives masculinity as a threat, perhaps because of unpleasant childhood experiences or the absence of an exemplary father, whereby the conversation returns to the crisis of fatherhood. He expresses the impression that that side wants to **"eliminate the father from the family equation"**, which, in his opinion, has been systematically happening for the last hundred to two hundred years. If the man is removed, the family collapses, and then the state or anyone else can do whatever they want with the children, the woman, and the family. Pokupec agrees: "That's right, there is no protection."

To those who disagree, Pokupec conveys two things. First: **one's own traumas cannot be healed by deepening the traumas of others**, that has never worked nor will it. Second: those who believe that men are not needed by the world, he says with a dose of irony, let them wait for the first power outage or the first major potholes on the road.

He calls feminism and "leftism" in general an unserious and short-sighted political and social ideology, founded on slogans that sound good at first, but make no sense as soon as they are thought through more deeply. Nevertheless, he says he can understand an idealistic leftist in high school or at university, who is led by the heart and youthful enthusiasm, which is positive if it is well directed.

Croatia's problem, according to his words, is that **it does not have a Croatian left, but a left in Croatia**. A Croatian left, according to the traditional division of political roles, would advocate for the Croatian worker, pensioner, person with disabilities, and abandoned child. The left in Croatia, he says, serves other interests—globalist, "outdated, Yugo-nationalist," or some third ones. He does not want, he adds, to enter into "famous conspiracy theories" about Soros and Freemasonry. When the left serves interests that are anyone's other than Croatian, dialogue is, he believes, difficult to achieve because the two sides do not have the well-being of the same people at heart. Some want to work for Croatia and the people in it, while the others, he concludes, serve others' interests, "consciously or unconsciously".
keywords_en: removing the father from the family

sections.subtitle: Vjera nije privatna stvar: svjedočanstvo i zaštita nerođenih kao prvi apostolat
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec govori da je tvrdnja kako je vjera privatna stvar perfidna podvala
sections.content:
Kruno primjećuje da se mnogi vjernici, osobito muškarci, ne žele priključiti javnim molitvama. Nekima medijski prikaz molitelja služi kao opravdanje, a drugi se jednostavno boje javno svjedočiti vjeru. Pita trebaju li se muškarci ohrabriti i javno moliti, što je i oblik evangelizacije na koju su vjernici pozvani.

Pokupec odgovara dvjema mislima iz Svetoga pisma. Prva glasi: **„Vjera se jača riječju svjedočanstva.“** Za kršćanina koji ne svjedoči pita se „čemu on služi“. Druga je poslanje Crkve, Kristove riječi: **„Idite i učinite sve narode mojim učenicima.“**

Izreku da je vjera privatna stvar naziva **„jako perfidnom podvalom“** koja je kroz kulturu, medije i politiku vrlo uspješno nametnuta. „Apsolutno ne“, kaže. Njegova privatna vjera, ističe, javna je stvar i on će je takvom i učiniti. Na svjedočenje nisu pozvani samo muškarci, nego svi vjernici, ali muškarci prvi, „u prvim redovima“.

Ponavlja da su vjernici problem stvorili sami sebi „donekle ženskom energijom“ u Katoličkoj crkvi, u kojoj se vjera poistovjećuje sa starim bakicama koje cijeli dan vrte krunicu. Mnogima, osobito u Hrvatskoj, vjera danas služi kao **skrovište**: unutar crkvenih zidova ili zidova zajednica netko je vjernik, a vani živi drugačiji život. Tako se, upozorava, ne može promijeniti ni vlastiti dom, a kamoli društvo, zemlja ili ljudi oko sebe. Vjernici su pozvani ponajprije svjedočiti svakodnevnim primjerom.

Pokupec potom iznosi svoje osobno mišljenje: **temeljni i prvi apostolat svakog vjernika jest biti za život**, odnosno zaštititi nevine, malene i nerođene. To je, kaže, odredio kao svoj prioritet broj jedan. Ako se ne zaštite nerođeni, pita, kojemu se svecu, kojim devetnicama i hodočašćima čovjek može posvetiti ako nije zaštitio „bespomoćnog nevinog“?

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak uglavnom promiče katolički nauk: kršćani su pozvani svjedočiti vjeru riječima i životom, a Kristov misijski nalog obuhvaća sve narode; ni vjera ni zaštita ljudskog života ne smiju se svesti na privatnu stvar. Ipak, tvrdnje da muškarci trebaju biti prvi te da je zaštita nerođenih prvi apostolat svakog vjernika iznose se previše kategorično, a biblijski navod o svjedočanstvu nije precizan citat.
concerns: Izreka „Vjera se jača riječju svjedočanstva” nije točan navod Otk 12,11: taj redak govori da su vjernici pobijedili Zloga krvlju Jaganjčevom i riječju svojega svjedočanstva, pa bi bilo primjerenije označiti izreku kao parafrazu ili je drukčije pripisati.

Tvrdnja da muškarci trebaju svjedočiti „prvi” i generalizacija o „ženskoj energiji” nisu utvrđene katoličkim naukom u navedenim izvorima; mogu nepotrebno stereotipizirati žene i umanjiti zajednički poziv svih vjernika na svjedočenje.

Zaštita nerođenih snažan je i važan oblik kršćanskog zalaganja za život, ali nazvati je bez kvalifikacije temeljnim i prvim apostolatom svakog vjernika može suziti apostolat na jedan prioritet. Rečenica koja dovodi u pitanje molitvu, pobožnosti ili hodočašća ako osoba nije zaštitila nerođene može zvučati kao da te prakse vrijede samo uz određeni aktivizam; odlomak ne daje osnovu za takav zaključak.
magisterium.enrichment: Kristov nalog da se svi narodi učine učenicima potvrđuje da evangelizacija nije ograničena na privatni život, a crkveno učenje povezuje navještaj Pisma sa svjedočanstvom života vjernika. Javno svjedočenje ipak treba biti poziv savjesti, a ne pritisak ili propaganda, te se očitovati u ljubavi prema ljudima i brizi za zajedničko dobro. Poštovanje ljudskog života i prihvaćanje života važni su etički zahtjevi, ali crkveni izvor smješta etičko poučavanje u širi kontekst života vjere, što pomaže izbjeći svođenje kršćanskog apostolata samo na jednu temu.

citations.document_author: The New Revised Standard Version, Catholic Edition (NRSV-CE)
The New Revised Standard Version, Catholic Edition (NRSV-CE)

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage generally promotes Catholic teaching: Christians are called to witness to the faith through words and life, and Christ's missionary mandate encompasses all nations; neither faith nor the protection of human life may be reduced to a private matter. However, the claims that men should be first and that the protection of the unborn is the first apostolate of every believer are stated too categorically, and the biblical reference to testimony is not an exact quotation.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Christ's mandate to make disciples of all nations confirms that evangelization is not limited to private life, and church teaching connects the proclamation of Scripture with the witness of believers' lives. Public witnessing should nevertheless be a call of conscience, not pressure or propaganda, and be manifested in love for people and care for the common good. Respect for human life and the welcoming of life are important ethical requirements, but the church source places ethical teaching in the broader context of the life of faith, which helps avoid reducing the Christian apostolate to only one topic.
concerns_en: The saying “Faith is strengthened by the word of testimony” is not an exact quotation of Rev 12:11: that verse states that believers conquered the Evil One by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony, so it would be more appropriate to label the saying as a paraphrase or attribute it differently.

The claim that men should witness “first” and the generalization about “feminine energy” are not established by Catholic teaching in the cited sources; they may unnecessarily stereotype women and diminish the common call of all believers to witness.

The protection of the unborn is a powerful and important form of Christian commitment to life, but calling it without qualification the fundamental and first apostolate of every believer can narrow the apostolate to a single priority. The sentence that calls into question prayer, devotions, or pilgrimages if a person has not protected the unborn can sound as if these practices are valid only alongside a certain activism; the passage provides no basis for such a conclusion.

sections.subtitle_en: Faith Is Not a Private Matter: Witness and the Protection of the Unborn as the First Apostolate
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec says that the claim that faith is a private matter is a perfidious deception
sections.content_en:
Kruno notes that many believers, especially men, do not want to join public prayers. For some, the media portrayal of those praying serves as an excuse, while others are simply afraid to publicly witness to their faith. He asks whether men should take courage and pray publicly, which is also a form of evangelization to which believers are called.

Pokupec responds with two thoughts from Sacred Scripture. The first reads: **“Faith is strengthened by the word of testimony.”** About a Christian who does not witness, he asks “what good is he.” The second is the mission of the Church, the words of Christ: **“Go and make disciples of all nations.”**

He calls the saying that faith is a private matter **“a very perfidious deception”** that has been very successfully imposed through culture, media, and politics. “Absolutely not,” he says. His private faith, he emphasizes, is a public matter and he will make it so. Not only men are called to witness, but all believers, but men first, “in the front ranks.”

He repeats that believers created the problem for themselves with “somewhat feminine energy” in the Catholic Church, in which faith is equated with old grandmothers who spin the Rosary all day long. To many, especially in Croatia, faith today serves as a **hiding place**: within church walls or community walls someone is a believer, but outside they live a different life. In this way, he warns, one cannot change even one's own home, let alone society, the country, or the people around oneself. Believers are called above all to witness by daily example.

Pokupec then presents his personal opinion: **the fundamental and first apostolate of every believer is to be pro-life**, that is, to protect the innocent, the little ones, and the unborn. That, he says, he determined as his priority number one. If the unborn are not protected, he asks, to which saint, to which novenas and pilgrimages can a person devote himself if he has not protected “the helpless innocent” human being?

sections.subtitle: „Bilo bi me sramota“: zavjet da nikad javno ne kritizira one koji rade za Kraljevstvo Božje
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec objašnjava odluku da više nikad javno ne kritizira istomišljenike
sections.content:
Pokupec upozorava na problem poznat iz politike. S jedne strane raste broj **laičkih molitvenih inicijativa**, što smatra savršenim i podržava. S druge strane, među njima su počela „koškanja“: jedna inicijativa uskraćuje podršku drugoj, iako se sve bore za istu stvar. Treba biti vrlo oprezan, kaže: motivirati vjernike da se negdje uključe i nešto poduzmu, ali ne dopustiti podvalu u kojoj jedni drugima podmeću klipove pod geslom „mi smo bolji, mi smo vrijedniji, mi nećemo podržati“. Njegov je stav jasan: **„Ja podržavam sve.“** Neće reći nijednu ružnu riječ protiv ikoga tko radi na Kraljevstvu Božjem jer bi ga, kaže, bilo sramota.

Kruno potvrđuje da se u posljednje vrijeme različite molitvene zajednice i inicijative „sotoniziraju“, umjesto da se međusobno podržavaju. Druga se strana, kaže, samo smije jer nije morala ništa učiniti ni plasirati ikakvu neistinu u medijima: vjernici su se posvađali sami.

Pokupec dodaje zapažanje koje mu je, kako kaže, nedavno „sinulo“: antiteisti i ljevičari to nikad ne rade jedni drugima. Ni kada se na ljevici pojave izjave koje su, prema njegovim riječima, na granici ilegalnog, a ne samo govora mržnje, oni se međusobno neće kritizirati. Možda će prešutjeti, ali kritizirati jedni druge neće. Kruno dodaje: „pogotovo ne javno“.

Na drugoj se strani, kaže Pokupec, događa suprotno, uz poznatu šalu: „dva Hrvata, 17 stranaka“. Čim netko „izleti“, odmah se proglašava ovakvim ili onakvim. Ne prodikuje, naglašava, jer je i sam tu grešku napravio „tisuću puta“. Sada je, međutim, svjesno odlučio da to više nikada neće učiniti javno. Većinu ljudi „s naše strane“ u politici poznaje osobno i s nekima se ne slaže u 85 posto stvari, ali o njima više nikada javno neće izreći nijednu negativnu riječ. Dok jedni drugima podmeću klipove, zaključuje, druga strana ide naprijed jer je povezuju interesi, „i smiju nam se u lice“.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na međusobnoj potpori, molitvi i izbjegavanju ogovaranja uglavnom je u skladu s kršćanskim pozivom na jedinstvo i ljubav, ali odluka da se nikada javno ne kaže ništa negativno o onima koji rade za Kraljevstvo Božje preširoka je ako se shvati kao zabrana nužne, istinite i ponizne javne korekcije. Crkveno jedinstvo ne traži prešućivanje pogreške: katolički izvori istodobno potiču obzir prema osobama i dopuštaju javno ukazivanje na javne pogreške.
concerns: Izjava „neću javno izreći nijednu negativnu riječ” može poistovjetiti svaku kritiku s neprijateljstvom ili razdorom. Sveto pismo razlikuje privatni prijestup, koji se najprije ispravlja nasamo, od javne pogreške koja zahtijeva javnu opomenu; sv. Pavao je, primjerice, javno ukorio Petra kada je njegovo ponašanje štetilo vjernosti evanđelju.

Potpora svim inicijativama ne znači da se svaka inicijativa unaprijed smatra ispravnom ili da se zanemaruju njezini nauk, metode i učinci. Crkveno učiteljstvo ističe da je zadaća pastira usklađivati apostolske inicijative i prosuđivati njihovu vjernost duhu Gospodnjem.
magisterium.enrichment: Kršćansko jedinstvo nije šutnja o razlikama: vjernici trebaju iskreno iznositi mišljenje o idejama i načinima djelovanja, ali uz poniznost, strpljivost, blagost i poštovanje osoba. Za privatne povrede prikladna je diskretna bratska opomena, dok se javna pogreška može ispravljati javno, s ciljem zaštite zajednice i povratka istini, a ne ponižavanja počinitelja. Stoga je najuravnoteženije podržavati dobro koje druge inicijative čine, moliti za njih i surađivati gdje je moguće, a istodobno ne odustati od razborite i odgovorne kritike kada je ona potrebna.

citations.document_title: Concordia testimoniorum S. Scripturae (Pope Gregory I)
Homily Against Publishing the Errors of the Brethren

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on mutual support, prayer, and avoiding gossip is generally in line with the Christian call to unity and love, but the decision to never publicly say anything negative about those who work for the Kingdom of God is too broad if understood as a prohibition of necessary, truthful, and humble public correction. Ecclesial unity does not demand keeping silent about error: Catholic sources simultaneously encourage consideration toward persons and permit publicly pointing out public errors.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Christian unity is not silence about differences: the faithful should honestly express their opinion about ideas and ways of acting, but with humility, patience, gentleness, and respect for persons. For private offenses, discreet fraternal correction is appropriate, while public error may be corrected publicly, with the goal of protecting the community and returning to the truth, not humiliating the perpetrator. Therefore, it is most balanced to support the good that other initiatives do, pray for them, and cooperate where possible, while at the same time not giving up prudent and responsible criticism when it is needed.
concerns_en: The statement "I will not publicly utter a single negative word" can equate all criticism with hostility or discord. Sacred Scripture distinguishes a private offense, which is first corrected in private, from a public error that requires public rebuke; St. Paul, for example, publicly rebuked Peter when his behavior harmed fidelity to the Gospel.

Support for all initiatives does not mean that every initiative is considered correct in advance or that its teaching, methods, and effects are ignored. The Magisterium of the Church emphasizes that it is the task of pastors to coordinate apostolic initiatives and judge their fidelity to the Spirit of the Lord.

sections.subtitle_en: "I would be ashamed": a vow never to publicly criticize those who work for the Kingdom of God
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec explains the decision to never again publicly criticize like-minded people
sections.content_en:
Pokupec warns of a problem known from politics. On the one hand, the number of **lay prayer initiatives** is growing, which he considers perfect and supports. On the other hand, "skirmishes" have started among them: one initiative withholds support from another, even though they are all fighting for the same thing. One must be very careful, he says: motivate the faithful to get involved somewhere and take action, but not allow the deception where they put spokes in each other's wheels under the slogan "we are better, we are more worthy, we will not support". His stance is clear: **"I support everyone."** He will not say a single bad word against anyone who works for the Kingdom of God because, he says, he would be ashamed.

Kruno confirms that lately various prayer communities and initiatives are being "demonized", instead of supporting each other. The other side, he says, is only laughing because they did not have to do anything or plant any untruth in the media: the faithful have quarreled among themselves.

Pokupec adds an observation that, as he says, recently "dawned" on him: antitheists and leftists never do that to each other. Even when statements appear on the left that are, in his words, on the verge of illegal, and not just hate speech, they will not criticize each other. They might keep silent about it, but they will not criticize each other. Kruno adds: "especially not publicly".

On the other side, Pokupec says, the opposite is happening, along with the well-known joke: "two Croats, 17 parties". As soon as someone "steps out of line", they are immediately labeled this way or that. He is not preaching, he emphasizes, because he himself made that mistake "a thousand times". Now, however, he has consciously decided that he will never do that publicly again. He knows most people "from our side" in politics personally and disagrees with some on 85 percent of things, but he will never again publicly utter a single negative word about them. While they put spokes in each other's wheels, he concludes, the other side is moving forward because it is connected by interests, "and they are laughing in our faces".

sections.subtitle: Priča zbog koje podcast uopće postoji
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec govori kako bi o njegovoj i Kruninoj zajedničkoj priči trebalo snimiti dokumentarac
sections.content:
Voditelj Kruno započinje temu koja je, prema vlastitom priznanju, ključna za cijeli razgovor. Nakon rasprave o podjelama među katolicima zaključuje da u tome često sudjeluje i velik ego kojemu tu nije mjesto. Ističe da bi upravo u **pro-life pokretu** svi trebali biti jednodušni, jer je cilj spasiti što više nerođenih života, ali i živote roditelja i što više duša.

Zatim gosta pita što ga je dovelo u borbu za život. Pritom priznaje da odgovor već dobro zna, ali želi da ga čuju i drugi. Kruno otvoreno kaže da je ta priča razlog zbog kojeg obojica danas sjede u studiju. Po njegovim riječima, ni njega ne bi bilo u ovom podcastu da se Ivanovoj obitelji nije dogodilo ono što se dogodilo.

Ivan Pokupec potvrđuje da je riječ o njihovoj zajedničkoj priči i dodaje da bi o njoj jednog dana trebalo snimiti dobar dokumentarac. Kaže da ni danas ne može pojmiti na koje je sve čudesne načine Bog tu djelovao. Za Boga u svom životu koristi slikovitu usporedbu: on je netko tko **malog Muju primi za kragnu i stavi na pravo mjesto u pravo vrijeme**.

Ivan objašnjava da je kao vjernik uvijek bio načelno protiv pobačaja. No naglašava da sve dobiva sasvim drugu dimenziju kada pobačaj uđe u život vlastite obitelji.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je snažno usklađen s katoličkim naukom jer potvrđuje pro-life zalaganje i prepoznaje Božju providnost u osobnoj i obiteljskoj povijesti; takvo poštovanje nerođenoga života odgovara biblijskom svjedočanstvu o Božjoj brizi za čovjeka već u majčinoj utrobi.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko razumijevanje obrane života uključuje i dostojanstvo djeteta od začeća i brižnu potporu majkama, roditeljima i svima koji su pogođeni trudnoćom ili pobačajem. Govor o Božjoj providnosti može se shvatiti kao osobno svjedočanstvo vjere: ne znači da je svaka životna okolnost lako razumljiva, nego da vjernik u događajima može prepoznavati Božje vodstvo, a da pritom ne ukida ljudsku slobodu i odgovornost.

United States Conference of Catholic Bishops

citations.document_title: To the Italian Pro-Life Movement (11 April 2014)

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is strongly aligned with Catholic teaching because it affirms pro-life commitment and recognizes God's providence in personal and family history; such respect for unborn life corresponds to the biblical testimony of God's care for man already in the mother's womb.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catholic understanding of the defense of life includes both the dignity of the child from conception and caring support for mothers, parents, and all who are affected by pregnancy or abortion. Discourse on God's providence can be understood as a personal testimony of faith: it does not mean that every circumstance of life is easily understood, but that a believer can recognize God's guidance in events without thereby negating human freedom and responsibility.

sections.subtitle_en: The story why the podcast exists at all
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec says that a documentary should be made about his and Kruno's shared story
sections.content_en:
Host Kruno begins a topic that is, by his own admission, key to the entire conversation. After a discussion about divisions among Catholics, he concludes that a large ego, which has no place there, often plays a part in this. He points out that precisely in the **pro-life movement** everyone should be unanimous, because the goal is to save as many unborn lives as possible, but also the lives of parents and as many souls as possible.

Then he asks the guest what brought him into the fight for life. At the same time, he admits that he already knows the answer well, but wants others to hear it too. Kruno openly says that this story is the reason why both of them are sitting in the studio today. In his words, he himself would not be in this podcast either had what happened to Ivan's family not happened.

Ivan Pokupec confirms that it is about their shared story and adds that one day a good documentary should be made about it. He says that even today he cannot comprehend all the miraculous ways in which God acted there. For God in his life he uses a vivid comparison: he is someone who **takes little Mujo by the collar and puts him in the right place at the right time**.

Ivan explains that as a believer he was always in principle against abortion. But he emphasizes that everything takes on a completely different dimension when abortion enters the life of one's own family.

sections.subtitle: Ultimatum: pobačaj ili se ne vraćaj kući
sections.screenshot_description: Gost opisuje ultimatum koji je obitelj trudne djevojke postavila svojoj kćeri
sections.content:
Ivan Pokupec u najkraćim crtama opisuje događaj koji mu je promijenio život. Njegov mlađi brat, gotovo punih deset godina mlađi od njega, postao je otac: njegova djevojka ostala je trudna. Oboje su tada bili mladi srednjoškolci.

Djevojčina obitelj inzistirala je na pobačaju iz, kako Ivan kaže, onih klasičnih razloga: da dijete ne uništi njezin život i da joj ne oduzme prilike. Kruno tome dodaje i pitanje „što će ljudi reći“. Na njegov upit Ivan potvrđuje da je djevojka bila maloljetna, imala je 17 i pol godina kada je zatrudnjela.

Ivan posebno naglašava jedan paradoks. Djevojčina obitelj, koja bi se i tada nazvala vjerničkom, postavila je ultimatum: **ili ćeš ići na pobačaj ili se ne vraćaj kući**. Najgore je, kaže, što su taj ultimatum na kraju i ispunili.

### Poziv „luđaku na najpozitivniji mogući način“

Ivan priznaje da je bio izgubljen i nije znao što napraviti ni kome se obratiti. Tada se sjetio **Ante Čaljkušića**, kojeg je poznavao s fakulteta i o kojem je čuo iz medija. S dozom humora ga opisuje kao „luđaka na najpozitivniji mogući način“ i dodaje da svatko tko ga poznaje zna koliko je specifičan. Kako se nije imao kome drugome okrenuti, pronašao je njegov kontakt s jednostavnom molbom: „Ante, pomozi.“

Od tog trenutka priča se, kako kaže, „razvezala“. Velikogorička ekipa inicijative **40 dana za život**, ljudi potpuno nepoznati njegovoj obitelji, ne samo da se uključila u slučaj, nego je bila spremna učiniti sve što je potrebno da se dijete spasi. Ivan se borbi pridružio zajedno s njima.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim naukom jer prikazuje pritisak da se pribjegne pobačaju kao razlog za zabrinutost i naglašava zauzimanje za spas nerođenog djeteta. Ipak, riječ je ponajprije o osobnom svjedočanstvu: odlomak izrijekom ne obrazlaže dostojanstvo nerođenog života niti pastoralnu potrebu da se pomogne i maloljetnoj trudnici.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk uči da ljudski život ima dostojanstvo od začeća te da se izravni pobačaj ne može opravdati teškoćama, pritiskom okoline ili strahom za budućnost; Sveto pismo ne osuđuje pobačaj izrijekom, ali njegovo poštovanje života u majčinoj utrobi vodi primjeni zapovijedi „Ne ubij” i na nerođeno dijete. Istodobno, pritisak na trudnicu i uskraćivanje potrebne podrške ozbiljni su pastoralni problemi, pa zaštita djeteta treba biti praćena konkretnom brigom za majku i njezine potrebe.

citations.document_author: Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith
Catholic Bishops’ Conference of England and Wales

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is largely aligned with Catholic teaching because it portrays pressure to resort to abortion as a cause for concern and emphasizes standing up for the salvation of the unborn child. Nevertheless, it is primarily a personal testimony: the passage does not explicitly explain the dignity of unborn life or the pastoral need to help the underage pregnant girl as well.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching teaches that human life has dignity from conception and that direct abortion cannot be justified by hardships, pressure from the environment, or fear for the future; Sacred Scripture does not explicitly condemn abortion, but its respect for life in the mother's womb leads to the application of the commandment “You shall not kill” to the unborn child as well. At the same time, pressure on a pregnant woman and the withholding of necessary support are serious pastoral problems, so the protection of the child should be accompanied by concrete care for the mother and her needs.

sections.subtitle_en: Ultimatum: abortion or do not return home
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest describes the ultimatum that the pregnant girl's family gave to their daughter
sections.content_en:
Ivan Pokupec in brief outlines describes the event that changed his life. His younger brother, almost a full ten years younger than him, became a father: his girlfriend became pregnant. Both were then young high school students.

The girl's family insisted on an abortion for, as Ivan says, those classic reasons: so that the child would not ruin her life and would not take away her opportunities. Kruno adds to that the question “what will people say”. To his inquiry, Ivan confirms that the girl was a minor, she was 17 and a half years old when she became pregnant.

Ivan particularly emphasizes one paradox. The girl's family, who would have called themselves believers even then, gave an ultimatum: **either you will go for an abortion or do not return home**. The worst thing, he says, is that they ultimately carried out that ultimatum.

### A call to a “madman in the most positive possible way”

Ivan admits that he was lost and did not know what to do or whom to turn to. Then he remembered **Ante Čaljkušić**, whom he knew from university and about whom he had heard in the media. With a dose of humor, he describes him as a “madman in the most positive possible way” and adds that everyone who knows him knows how specific he is. Since he had no one else to turn to, he found his contact with a simple plea: “Ante, help.”

From that moment on, the story, as he says, “unraveled”. The Velika Gorica team of the initiative **40 dana za život**, people completely unknown to his family, not only got involved in the case, but was ready to do whatever it takes to save the child. Ivan joined the fight together with them.

sections.subtitle: Julijan, hodajući blagoslov
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec s emocijom opisuje nećaka Julijana kao hodajući blagoslov
sections.content:
Priča ima sretan kraj. **Julijan** je rođen 8. prosinca 2016. godine. Danas je školarac, a Ivan ga opisuje kao predivno dijete i „predivnog dječačića“.

Prema Ivanovim riječima, Julijan je donio velike blagoslove ne samo u život njegova brata i bratove supruge, nego i cijele obitelji. Kad bi se netko dao na posao, kaže, trebalo bi ispisati dobar A4 list papira o svemu što je to dijete promijenilo u njihovim životima. Zaključuje kratko: **Julijan je i danas hodajući blagoslov.**

magisterium.assessment: Opisivanje Julijana kao „hodajućeg blagoslova” u skladu je s katoličkim razumijevanjem djeteta kao Božjeg dara i izvora radosti za obitelj. Riječ je o osobnom svjedočanstvu zahvalnosti, a ne o tvrdnji da se Božji blagoslov može mjeriti samo rođenjem djeteta.
magisterium.enrichment: Crkveno učenje govori o djeci kao „vrhunskom daru” i podsjeća da obitelji mogu postati škole ljudskosti i solidarnosti. Psalm 127 također prikazuje djecu kao baštinu i dar od Gospodina, što pruža biblijski okvir za ovakvu obiteljsku zahvalnost.
magisterium.assessment_en: Describing Julijan as a „walking blessing” is in accordance with the Catholic understanding of a child as God's gift and a source of joy for the family. It is a matter of a personal testimony of gratitude, and not of a claim that God's blessing can only be measured by the birth of a child.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Church teaching speaks of children as the „supreme gift” and reminds that families can become schools of humanity and solidarity. Psalm 127 also portrays children as a heritage and a gift from the Lord, which provides a biblical framework for this kind of family gratitude.

sections.subtitle_en: Julijan, a walking blessing
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec with emotion describes nephew Julijan as a walking blessing
sections.content_en:
The story has a happy ending. **Julijan** was born on December 8, 2016. Today he is a schoolboy, and Ivan describes him as a wonderful child and a „wonderful little boy”.

According to Ivan's words, Julijan brought great blessings not only into the life of his brother and his brother's wife, but also the entire family. If someone were to set to work, he says, it would take filling a good A4 sheet of paper about everything that this child changed in their lives. He concludes briefly: **Julijan is even today a walking blessing.**

sections.subtitle: Od zahvalnosti do inicijative u Križevcima
sections.screenshot_description: Gost objašnjava kako je odlučio pokrenuti inicijativu 40 dana za život u Križevcima
sections.content:
Ivan Pokupec kaže da ga je ta borba mnogo naučila. Izbliza je vidio na koje se sve načine zlo urotilo da ubije to dijete i da „otrgne taj život“. Nakon toga osjetio se pozvanim uzvratiti inicijativi koja mu je pomogla.

U to su vrijeme imali neslužbenu informaciju da se u **Domu zdravlja u Križevcima** nelegalno izvode pobačaji. Ivan je zaključio da inicijativi može najbolje uzvratiti tako da je proširi, pa je pokrenuta i u Križevcima.

Uslijedio je, kako kaže, novi blagoslov: uključio se i Kruno, koji je, u Ivanovim riječima, „to preuzeo onako muški“. Prema njihovim saznanjima, **pobačaji u Križevcima potom su potpuno zaustavljeni**.

Ivan nabraja kako im je sve „stostruko vraćeno“:
- inicijativa se dodatno proširila,
- Julijan danas ima mlađeg brata,
- životi njegova mlađeg brata i bratove supruge, koji su prije „išli nigdje“, sada imaju smisao i cilj.

Iz svega toga, zaključuje Ivan, proizašlo je i njegovo poslanje: blagoslov koji je dobila njegova obitelj proširiti na što više strana.

magisterium.assessment: Zalaganje za zaštitu nerođenog života i pokretanje molitvene inicijative u skladu je s katoličkim naukom, koji potvrđuje dostojanstvo ljudskog života prije rođenja i potiče molitvu te djelovanje za njegovu zaštitu. Ipak, tvrdnje o navodnim ilegalnim pobačajima i njihovu potpunom zaustavljanju prikazane su kao lokalna saznanja, a ne kao provjerene činjenice; izraz o životima koji su prije „išli nigdje” također traži oprez da se smisao života ne shvati kao nešto što osoba dobiva tek nakon promjene životnog smjera.
concerns: Navod da su se u Domu zdravlja nelegalno izvodili pobačaji i tvrdnja da su oni potom potpuno zaustavljeni nisu potvrđeni dostupnim izvorima; treba ih predstavljati kao tvrdnje govornika, a ne kao utvrđene činjenice.

Formulacija da su životi brata i njegove supruge prije „išli nigdje” može zvučati kao da je njihovo dostojanstvo ili smisao života ovisio o kasnijoj promjeni. Katolički pogled dopušta govor o obraćenju i novom usmjerenju, ali ljudsko dostojanstvo ne ovisi o takvom iskustvu.
Izraz da se zlo „urotilo” protiv djeteta može se razumjeti kao duhovna ili retorička metafora; ne bi ga trebalo prikazivati kao dokaz da je svaki nepovoljan događaj posljedica izravne zavjere.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolička tradicija vidi nerođeni život kao vrijedan zaštite, a Sveto pismo govori o Božjoj brizi za čovjeka još u majčinoj utrobi (Ps 139,13–16; Lk 1,43–44). Molitvena bdjenja i pro-life inicijative mogu biti prikladan dio tog zalaganja, koje treba pratiti suosjećanje i praktična pomoć ženama, djeci i obiteljima. Svjedočanstvo o osobnom poslanju može izraziti zahvalnost i želju da se dobro širi, uz jasnoću da smisao i dostojanstvo svake osobe potječu od Boga, a ne samo iz određenog životnog ishoda.

citations.document_author: Catholic Bishops’ Conference of England and Wales
United States Conference of Catholic Bishops
United States Conference of Catholic Bishops

magisterium.assessment_en: Advocacy for the protection of unborn life and launching a prayer initiative is in accordance with Catholic teaching, which affirms the dignity of human life before birth and encourages prayer and action for its protection. Nevertheless, claims about alleged illegal abortions and their complete cessation are presented as local findings rather than verified facts; the expression about lives that previously were "going nowhere" also requires caution so that the meaning of life is not understood as something a person receives only after a change in life's direction.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic tradition sees unborn life as worthy of protection, and Sacred Scripture speaks of God's care for man already in the mother's womb (Ps 139:13–16; Lk 1:43–44). Prayer vigils and pro-life initiatives can be a fitting part of that advocacy, which should be accompanied by compassion and practical help for women, children, and families. A testimony of personal mission can express gratitude and the desire for good to spread, along with clarity that the meaning and dignity of every person originate from God, and not merely from a specific outcome in life.
concerns_en: The allegation that abortions were performed illegally at the Health Center and the claim that they were subsequently completely stopped are not confirmed by available sources; they should be presented as claims of the speaker, not as established facts.

The formulation that the lives of the brother and his wife previously were "going nowhere" may sound as though their dignity or the meaning of their lives depended on a subsequent change. The Catholic view allows for speaking of conversion and a new direction, but human dignity does not depend on such an experience.

The expression that evil "conspired" against the child can be understood as a spiritual or rhetorical metaphor; it should not be presented as proof that every unfavorable event is the result of a direct conspiracy.

sections.subtitle_en: From gratitude to an initiative in Križevci
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest explains how he decided to launch the 40 Days for Life initiative in Križevci
sections.content_en:
Ivan Pokupec says that this struggle taught him a lot. He saw up close all the ways evil conspired to kill that child and to "tear that life away." After that, he felt called to give back to the initiative that had helped him.

At that time, they had unofficial information that abortions were being performed illegally at the **Health Center in Križevci**. Ivan concluded that he could best give back to the initiative by expanding it, so it was launched in Križevci as well.

What followed, as he says, was a new blessing: Kruno also joined, who, in Ivan's words, "took that on like a real man." According to their knowledge, **abortions in Križevci were subsequently completely stopped**.

Ivan lists all the ways they were "repaid a hundredfold":
- the initiative expanded even further,
- Julijan today has a younger brother,
- the lives of his younger brother and his brother's wife, which previously were "going nowhere," now have meaning and a goal.

From all of this, Ivan concludes, his mission also emerged: to spread the blessing his family received in as many directions as possible.

sections.subtitle: Kruno: dječak kojeg nikad nisam upoznao promijenio mi je život
sections.screenshot_description: Voditelj Kruno priča kako ga je Julijanova priča uvela u pro-life i apostolat za muškarce
sections.content:
Kruno smatra da Ivanova priča savršeno pokazuje vrijednost jednog nerođenog života. Takav život, kaže, može promijeniti sudbinu ne samo jedne obitelji nego i mnogih drugih ljudi.

Voditelj zatim opisuje lanac događaja u vlastitom životu. Julijan je potaknuo Ivana da pokrene inicijativu u Križevcima. Ta je inicijativa Kruno uvela u pro-life, a pro-life ga je doveo do **apostolata za muškarce**. Uvidio je, naime, da se pobačaj većinom događa zbog **krize muževnosti**.

Kruno priznaje da Julijana nikada nije upoznao, iako je bio u njegovim molitvama, ali da mu je taj dječak promijenio život. Dok je slušao Ivana o borbi za njegova nećaka, zapitao se što bi bilo da se to dogodi njegovu nećaku i da se za njegov život vodi isti duhovni rat. Kaže da je u Ivanovu nećaku prepoznao vlastitog.

Iz toga izvodi pouku: važno je da svi osvijeste kako su nerođeni životi njihova obitelj, njihova braća i sestre.

magisterium.assessment: Naglasak na dostojanstvu nerođenoga života, pro-life djelovanju i solidarnosti s nerođenima u skladu je s katoličkim naukom: Crkva uči da ljudski život treba štititi od začeća te da biblijski tekstovi svjedoče o Božjoj brizi za čovjeka u majčinoj utrobi. Ipak, tvrdnja da se pobačaj većinom događa zbog „krize muževnosti” izrečena je kao općenito objašnjenje bez potpore u navedenim izvorima i može nepravedno pojednostaviti složene okolnosti.
concerns: Uzročnu tvrdnju o „krizi muževnosti” treba iznijeti opreznije: dostupni izvori potvrđuju obvezu zaštite nerođenih i podrške obiteljima, ali ne utvrđuju da je kriza muževnosti glavni ili većinski uzrok pobačaja.
magisterium.enrichment: Katoličko vrednovanje nerođenoga života temelji se na njegovu dostojanstvu, a ne na zdravlju, sposobnostima ili okolnostima začeća; biblijska svjedočanstva o Božjoj brizi za čovjeka u utrobi podupiru taj pogled. Govor o nerođenima kao o „našoj obitelji” može se razumjeti kao poziv na solidarnost i odgovornost za svakoga čovjeka, uz poštovanje posebnih veza i stvarnih okolnosti pojedinih obitelji. Pro-life djelovanje zato uključuje ne samo obranu života nego i izgradnju potpore majkama, djeci i obiteljima.

United States Conference of Catholic Bishops

citations.document_title: To the leaders of the International "Pro-Life" Movement (November 15, 1991) - Speech

magisterium.assessment_en: The emphasis on the dignity of unborn life, pro-life activity, and solidarity with the unborn is in accordance with Catholic teaching: the Church teaches that human life should be protected from conception and that biblical texts testify to God's care for man in the mother's womb. However, the claim that abortion mostly happens because of a "crisis of masculinity" is stated as a general explanation without support in the cited sources and may unfairly oversimplify complex circumstances.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The Catholic valuation of unborn life is based on its dignity, not on health, abilities, or circumstances of conception; biblical testimonies of God's care for man in the womb support this view. Speaking of the unborn as "our family" can be understood as a call to solidarity and responsibility for every person, respecting the special bonds and real circumstances of individual families. Pro-life activity therefore includes not only the defense of life, but also building support for mothers, children, and families.
concerns_en: The causal claim about the "crisis of masculinity" should be presented more cautiously: available sources confirm the obligation to protect the unborn and support families, but do not establish that a crisis of masculinity is the primary or majority cause of abortion.

sections.subtitle_en: Kruno: the boy I never met changed my life
sections.screenshot_description_en: Host Kruno talks about how Julijan's story led him into pro-life and the apostolate for men
sections.content_en:
Kruno believes that Ivan's story perfectly shows the value of an unborn life. Such a life, he says, can change the fate of not only one family, but also of many other people.

The host then describes a chain of events in his own life. Julijan prompted Ivan to start an initiative in Križevci. That initiative led Kruno into pro-life, and pro-life led him to the **apostolate for men**. Namely, he saw that abortion mostly happens because of a **crisis of masculinity**.

Kruno admits that he never met Julijan, even though he was in his prayers, but that this boy changed his life. While he listened to Ivan about the struggle for his nephew, he wondered what it would be like if that happened to his nephew and if the same spiritual warfare were fought for his life. He says that in Ivan's nephew he recognized his own.

From this he draws a lesson: it is important for everyone to become aware that unborn lives are their family, their brothers and sisters.

sections.subtitle: „Gdje ti je brat?“ i pitanje koje je promijenilo Ivanov stav
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec prepričava trenutak kada ga je Kruno pitao može li ubojstvo biti legalno
sections.content:
Kruno svoj angažman povezuje s biblijskim pitanjem s prvih stranica Svetog pisma: **„Gdje ti je brat?“** Kaže da mu upravo ta rečenica uvijek dolazi na um kada razmišlja hoće li otići na bdijenje ispred doma zdravlja ili bolnice. Netko se možda baš tada bori za život, objašnjava, i potrebno je da ondje stoji, svjedoči i mirno moli. Njegova prisutnost može nekoga odvratiti od pobačaja i spasiti nerođeno dijete.

Ivan Pokupec dodaje da se blagoslov koji je preko Julijana stigao do Krune vratio i njemu. Živo se sjeća svojih tadašnjih dvojbi. Što se tiče pobačaja u vlastitom životu, obitelji i užoj okolini, sve mu je bilo jasno. No smatrao je da bi možda bilo licemjerno određivati drugima, jer je „svačija situacija drugačija“.

Tada mu je Kruno postavio jednostavno pitanje: **može li ubojstvo biti legalno?** Ivan priznaje da je zastao i zapitao se vjeruje li doista da je pobačaj ubojstvo. Zaključio je da nesumnjivo jest, a ako je ubojstvo, onda nikako ne može biti legalan.

Ivan svjestan je da će druga strana reći kako je postao radikalniji nego prije. On sam smatra da je sada **razumniji**, jer mu je jasan širi kontekst pobačaja. Zaključuje da su on i Kruno u cijeloj priči „poslužili jedan drugome“.

Kruno priznaje da se tog svog komentara iskreno ne sjeća. Vidi ga kao Boga na djelu i jednu njegovu veliku providnost.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim naukom: zaštitu nerođenoga prikazuje kao odgovornost prema bližnjemu, a izravni pobačaj prepoznaje kao teško moralno zlo koje se ne može opravdati okolnostima. Ipak, pitanje „može li ubojstvo biti legalno?” zahtijeva razlikovanje između zakona koji nešto faktično dopušta i zakona koji je moralno pravedan; pobačaj može biti dopušten pozitivnim zakonom, ali to ga ne čini moralno dopuštenim.
concerns: Izraz „ako je ubojstvo, onda nikako ne može biti legalan” može zamagliti razliku između pravne valjanosti zakona u državi i njegove moralne opravdanosti. Katolički nauk jasno odbacuje moralnu legitimnost izravnog pobačaja, ali pravni sustav ga u praksi može legalizirati.

Tvrdnja da je pobačaj ubojstvo usklađena je s crkvenim opisom izravnog pobačaja kao namjernog usmrćenja nedužnog ljudskog bića, no bilo bi korisno razlikovati moralnu narav čina od osobne krivnje pojedinca, osobito u teškim i složenim okolnostima.
magisterium.enrichment: Pitanje „Gdje je brat Abel?” u Postanku poziva na odgovornost za život drugoga, pa njegovo povezivanje sa zauzimanjem za nerođene ima razumljiv biblijski smisao. Crkva naučava da ljudski život treba štititi od začeća te da izravni pobačaj, htijen kao cilj ili sredstvo, uvijek ostaje teško moralno zlo; ozbiljne ili bolne okolnosti mogu objasniti nečiju odluku, ali same po sebi ne čine čin moralno dopuštenim. Stoga je zalaganje za život i mirna molitva prikazano u odlomku u skladu s tim naukom, uz važnu napomenu da se zaštita života treba izražavati istinito i s poštovanjem prema osobama u teškoj situaciji.

Congregation for the Doctrine of the Faith

magisterium.assessment_en: The passage is largely aligned with Catholic teaching: it presents the protection of the unborn as a responsibility toward one's neighbor, and recognizes direct abortion as a grave moral evil that cannot be justified by circumstances. Nevertheless, the question "can murder be legal?" requires a distinction between a law that factually permits something and a law that is morally just; abortion may be permitted by positive law, but that does not make it morally permissible.
magisterium.enrichment_en: The question "Where is Abel your brother?" in Genesis calls for responsibility for the life of another, so connecting it with standing up for the unborn has an understandable biblical sense. The Church teaches that human life must be protected from conception and that direct abortion, willed as an end or a means, always remains a grave moral evil; serious or painful circumstances can explain someone's decision, but do not in themselves make the act morally permissible. Therefore, advocacy for life and peaceful prayer presented in the passage is in accordance with this teaching, with the important note that the protection of life should be expressed truthfully and with respect toward persons in difficult situations.
concerns_en: The phrase "if it is murder, then it can by no means be legal" can obscure the distinction between the legal validity of a law in a state and its moral justification. Catholic teaching clearly rejects the moral legitimacy of direct abortion, but a legal system can legalize it in practice.

The assertion that abortion is murder is aligned with the Church's description of direct abortion as the deliberate killing of an innocent human being, but it would be useful to distinguish the moral nature of the act from the personal guilt of the individual, especially in difficult and complex circumstances.

sections.subtitle_en: "Where is your brother?" and the question that changed Ivan's stance
sections.screenshot_description_en: Ivan Pokupec recounts the moment when Kruno asked him whether murder could be legal
sections.content_en:
Kruno connects his involvement with the biblical question from the first pages of Sacred Scripture: **"Where is your brother?"** He says that precisely this sentence always comes to his mind when he considers whether to go to a vigil in front of a health center or hospital. Someone might be fighting for life at that very moment, he explains, and it is necessary for him to stand there, witness, and peacefully pray. His presence can dissuade someone from abortion and save an unborn child.

Ivan Pokupec adds that the blessing that reached Kruno through Julijan returned to him as well. He vividly remembers his doubts at the time. Regarding abortion in his own life, family, and immediate surroundings, everything was clear to him. But he considered that it might be hypocritical to dictate to others, because "everyone's situation is different".

Then Kruno asked him a simple question: **can murder be legal?** Ivan admits that he paused and asked himself whether he truly believed that abortion is murder. He concluded that it undoubtedly is, and if it is murder, then it can by no means be legal.

Ivan is aware that the other side will say he has become more radical than before. He himself considers that he is now **more reasonable**, because the broader context of abortion is clear to him. He concludes that in the whole story, he and Kruno "served one another".

Kruno admits that he honestly does not remember that comment of his. He sees it as God at work and a great providence of His.

sections.subtitle: Šimun: 30 posto šanse i šest operacija
sections.screenshot_description: Gost opisuje tešku malformaciju ošita s kojom je rođen njegov sin Šimun
sections.content:
Kruno primjećuje da se u ovoj i drugim Ivanovim pričama osjeća „Božji prst“. Budući da se epizoda bliži kraju, pita ga o sinu i o projektu koji je nastao nakon sinove bolesti, a danas pomaže mnogima.

Ivan Pokupec priča o mlađem sinu **Šimunu**, rođenom krajem 2015. godine s teškom malformacijom unutarnjih organa. Šimunov se **ošit nije do kraja zatvorio** prije rođenja. Budući da je beba u maternici okrenuta naopačke, organi trbušne šupljine prešli su u prsnu šupljinu i, kako Ivan kaže, „svi su se organi pomiješali“.

Šimun je fizički bio velika beba, težak 4600 grama i dug pedesetak centimetara. U sebi je ipak nosio jedan od najtežih poremećaja. Roditeljima su rekli da je to stanje do 2006. bilo neoperabilno i značilo sigurnu smrtnu presudu.

### Pobačaj kao prva ponuđena opcija

Dijagnozu su doznali već na ultrazvuku, a prvo što im je predloženo bio je **pobačaj**. Ivan to izdvaja kao zanimljivu epizodu: po njegovu iskustvu, ginekolozi danas često nude pobačaj kao jednu od opcija.

Šimunu su dali **30 posto šanse za preživljavanje**. Rodio se, a zatim je slijedila prva operacija, pa druga, treća, sve do šeste. Danas je desetogodišnjak koji zna sve o dinosaurima, gušterima i žabama i kod kuće izrađuje terarije. Ivan ga s ponosom naziva „zjenicom tatinog oka“.

magisterium.assessment: Pripovijest je uglavnom usklađena s katoličkim naukom jer prikazuje dijete s teškom malformacijom kao osobu vrijednu skrbi te odbacuje pobačaj kao odgovor na prenatalnu dijagnozu. Tvrdnja da ginekolozi danas često nude pobačaj izrečena je kao široka generalizacija koja se ne može procijeniti samo na temelju ovog osobnog svjedočanstva.
concerns: Anegdota o ponuđenom pobačaju može biti važna, ali ne dokazuje da ginekolozi općenito često postupaju tako; prenatalna dijagnostika sama po sebi nije nemoralna kada služi dobrobiti majke ili djeteta, dok je njezina uporaba radi selektivnog pobačaja moralno nedopuštena.
Podaci o 30-postotnoj šansi za preživljavanje i tvrdnja da je stanje prije 2006. značilo sigurnu smrt medicinske su tvrdnje koje se iz odlomka ne mogu neovisno provjeriti.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk uči da je ljudski život svet i nepovrediv od začeća te da malformacija ne umanjuje dostojanstvo djeteta ni njegovu vrijednost kao pacijenta. Crkva razlikuje dopuštenu prenatalnu dijagnostiku i liječenje usmjereno na dobro djeteta od dijagnostike koja se koristi za odabir pobačaja; pobačaj je namjerno usmrćenje nedužnog ljudskog života i nikada nije dopušten. Šest operacija i današnji život Šimuna mogu se razumjeti kao primjer skrbi i pratnje bolesnog djeteta, bez zaključka da svako medicinsko stanje mora imati isti ishod ili da su svi zahvati uvijek moralno obvezni.

magisterium.assessment_en: The narrative is largely aligned with Catholic teaching because it depicts a child with a severe malformation as a person worthy of care and rejects abortion as a response to a prenatal diagnosis. The claim that gynecologists today often offer abortion is stated as a broad generalization that cannot be evaluated solely on the basis of this personal testimony.
magisterium.enrichment_en: Catholic teaching teaches that human life is sacred and inviolable from conception and that a malformation does not diminish the dignity of the child or their worth as a patient. The Church distinguishes permissible prenatal diagnostics and treatment directed toward the child's good from diagnostics used to choose abortion; abortion is the intentional killing of innocent human life and is never permissible. The six surgeries and Šimun's life today can be understood as an example of care and accompaniment of a sick child, without concluding that every medical condition must have the same outcome or that all interventions are always morally obligatory.
concerns_en: The anecdote about abortion being offered may be significant, but it does not prove that gynecologists generally often act in this way; prenatal diagnostics is not in itself immoral when it serves the well-being of the mother or the child, whereas its use for the purpose of selective abortion is morally illicit.
The data about a 30 percent chance of survival and the claim that the condition prior to 2006 meant certain death are medical claims that cannot be independently verified from the passage.

sections.subtitle_en: Šimun: A 30 Percent Chance and Six Surgeries
sections.screenshot_description_en: The guest describes the severe diaphragmatic malformation with which his son Šimun was born
sections.content_en:
Kruno notes that "the finger of God" can be felt in this and other stories of Ivan's. As the episode draws to a close, he asks him about his son and about the project that came about after his son's illness and helps many people today.

Ivan Pokupec speaks about his younger son **Šimun**, born at the end of 2015 with a severe malformation of internal organs. Šimun's **diaphragm did not fully close** before birth. Since the baby is turned upside down in the womb, the organs of the abdominal cavity moved into the chest cavity and, as Ivan says, "all the organs got mixed up."

Šimun was physically a large baby, weighing 4,600 grams and about fifty centimeters long. Yet inside he carried one of the most severe disorders. The parents were told that until 2006 this condition was inoperable and meant a certain death sentence.

### Abortion as the First Offered Option

They found out about the diagnosis already on ultrasound, and the first thing suggested to them was **abortion**. Ivan highlights this as an interesting episode: according to his experience, gynecologists today often offer abortion as one of the options.

They gave Šimun a **30 percent chance of survival**. He was born, and then followed the first surgery, then the second, the third, all the way to the sixth. Today he is a ten-year-old who knows everything about dinosaurs, lizards, and frogs and makes terrariums at home. Ivan proudly calls him "the apple of his father's eye."

sections.subtitle: Od „kućne kreme“ do obiteljskog posla Astopic
sections.screenshot_description: Ivan Pokupec opisuje kako je supruga farmaceutkinja napravila kremu za sina
sections.content:
Uz sve teške dijagnoze, Šimun je dobio i **atopijski dermatitis**. Ivan priznaje da se nakon životno opasnih operacija atopijski dermatitis činio manjim problemom. Ipak, obitelj se s njim godinama borila bez uspjeha.

Preokret je donijela njegova supruga, **magistra farmacije** po struci. Kad je vidjela da konvencionalni pristup ne donosi rješenje, odlučila je nešto poduzeti sama. Kod kuće je napravila **kremu bez kortikosteroida**, koju su tada zvali jednostavno „kućna krema“, i ona je Šimunu pomagala.

Priča se zatim, kako Ivan kaže, Božjom providnošću i gotovo polusvjesno počela širiti. Kremu su tražili prijatelji, pa prijatelji prijatelja, pa njihovi prijatelji. Ivan se vraća na misao s početka razgovora da mu treba dugo da sazrije u nekim stvarima. Tek nakon nekoliko godina sinulo mu je: ako krema pomaže svim tim ljudima, zašto je ne bi učinili široko dostupnom?

Tako je nastao **Astopic**. Ivan ga opisuje kao hrvatski proizvod nastao iz ljubavi jedne majke prema djetetu. Uskoro slavi prvu godišnjicu, a prema Ivanovim riječima već je srušio mnoge rekorde hrvatske kozmetičke industrije:
- polako kreće u izvoz,
- ima ogroman broj kupaca,
- skupio je stotine pozitivnih recenzija,
- bilježi konstantan rast, iako je tek na početku.

Ivan zaključuje da je Bog iz jedne nevolje i velikog problema stvorio nešto nemjerljivo blagoslovljeno, a to je postalo uspješan obiteljski posao.

magisterium.assessment: Odlomak je uglavnom usklađen s katoličkim razumijevanjem Božje providnosti, obiteljskog zalaganja i ljudskog rada: majčina stručnost i trud opisani su kao stvarna sredstva kojima je nastalo dobro za druge. Ipak, riječ o „blagoslovljenom” uspjehu valja razumjeti kao zahvalno tumačenje iskustva, a ne kao dokaz da poslovni uspjeh uvijek potvrđuje Božju naklonost ili da je bolest bila poslana radi nastanka proizvoda.
concerns: Povezivanje nevolje s uspješnim poslom može, ako se shvati kao opće pravilo, ostaviti dojam da se Božja providnost mjeri ozdravljenjem, popularnošću ili rastom prihoda; katolički nauk ne svodi Božju blizinu na zemaljski uspjeh.
Navodi o djelovanju kreme i njezinim kupcima poslovne su tvrdnje koje se iz ovog odlomka ne mogu teološki ni medicinski potvrditi.
magisterium.enrichment: Katolički nauk o providnosti dopušta da se Božje djelovanje ostvaruje kroz ljudske sposobnosti i uzroke: majčino znanje farmacije, obiteljski trud i poduzetnost mogu biti stvarni načini služenja bližnjima, a ne suparnici Božjem djelovanju. Rad može pridonositi uzdržavanju i stabilnosti obitelji, dok kršćansko razumijevanje patnje istodobno upozorava da se svaka bolest ne smije tumačiti kao nešto što je Bog izravno htio radi kasnije koristi.
